description:
Cabana is growing our paid acquisition team and looking for a Performance Marketing Specialist  to drive performance across Google and Meta.



If you're the kind of media buyer who gets energized by a messy dataset, a stubborn CPA, or a landing page that's underperforming, this role is built for you.



Follow These Instructions to Stand Out:



PLEASE SEND THE FOLLOWING:



1. Share your desired hourly rate in USD.

2. Include your availability, hours per week, and start date.

3. Use "Performance Marketing Specialist" as your email subject line.

4. If you have paid media experience in health, pharma, telehealth, supplements, OTC, medical devices, or another regulated health category, add "+ Health" to the subject line.



Example: Performance Marketing Specialist + Health



5. Provide a link to your resume, portfolio, or relevant work samples.

6. Include at least 1–2 screenshots from real campaigns, ad accounts, or campaign reports you've managed. Private or client information can be blacked out.



We want to see how you think, not just what platforms you've touched.



Applications with relevant medical, telehealth, pharma, wellness, or other regulated category experience will be prioritized.



About Cabana:

Cabana is a modern wellness brand built to help people feel lighter, brighter, and more confident every day.



Across weight, hormones, sexual wellness, skin, sleep, and energy, we offer personalized health solutions through a chic, digital-first platform — equal parts modern health club and boutique wellness destination.



Our website: 



Full Job Description:

At Cabana, we're building wellness experiences that feel as good as they work — and that starts with how we acquire customers.



We're hiring a PPC Manager to take ownership of our paid growth engine on Google and Meta: testing, optimizing, and scaling campaigns that actually convert, not just generate clicks.



Because we operate in the wellness space, our ads run alongside health and pharmacy policies on both platforms. Candidates with experience in regulated health categories will have a real head start here.



Beyond the résumé, we're looking for someone sharp — someone who can read data quickly, spot what's actually working, and make fast, smart calls.



We're a small, ambitious team building something fresh: a brand where science is simplified, self-care feels elevated, and health feels like a luxury.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Test and optimize audiences, creative, landing pages, and messaging to move CTR, CPA, ROAS, and conversion rate

- Analyze performance data and translate it into clear next steps

- Manage campaign structure, bidding strategies, and budget pacing across Google and Meta

- Monitor account health and stay ahead of policy issues

- Partner with creative to keep ads on-brand and high-performing

- Build and refine funnels that convert without losing the brand

- Own paid growth end-to-end, from build to reporting



What We're Looking For:

- 3+ years running paid media on Meta and Google with real budget responsibility

- Strong analytical instincts and an eye for what the data is actually telling you

- Experience managing campaigns with clear performance goals

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and own outcomes

- Clear English communication

- Ability to overlap with US Pacific business hours



Strongly Preferred:

- Paid media experience in health, pharma, telehealth, supplements, OTC, medical devices, or other regulated categories

- Familiarity with Meta and Google's health and pharmacy ad policies

- Awareness of LegitScript certification and HIPAA-aware marketing practices

- Understanding of conversion data, retargeting constraints, tracking limitations, and compliant messaging



Nice to Have:

- Experience with Meta Business Help Center appeals, policy violation reviews, or account reinstatement

- Understanding of why health/wellness ad accounts commonly get flagged (health claims, before/after imagery, restricted content)

- Experience with Business Manager structure, backup BMs, or domain verification as safeguards against future restrictions

- Google healthcare/pharma certification familiarity

- Event tracking and analytics (
, Google Tag Manager, server-side tracking, CAPI)

- Experience with Pinterest, TikTok, X, programmatic, or other paid channels

- DTC or subscription brand experience



What It's Like Working With Us

[] Work from anywhere that inspires you

[] Flexible schedule, with some overlap during US Pacific business hours

[] Paid Philippine holidays

[] Supportive, no-drama team that values balance as much as results

[] Be part of a brand that blends science with style, because wellness should feel as good as it works

title: Senior Salesforce / Litify Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Developer to take ownership of a significant Salesforce/Litify implementation and integration project for our company.



This is not a basic Salesforce administrator position. We need someone who is comfortable designing solutions, migrating and cleaning large amounts of existing data, building Salesforce automations, working with APIs, and integrating third-party platforms.



The Project



Our company currently has a significant amount of business and client/lead data stored in spreadsheets. We need to migrate this information into Salesforce/Litify and build a reliable Salesforce environment that our team can use going forward.



A major part of the project will also be integrating our calling platform, PhoneBurner, with Salesforce/Litify so that our team can efficiently make calls while keeping contact information, call activity, statuses, notes, and other relevant information synchronized.



You will help us design the system correctly rather than simply copying our existing spreadsheets into Salesforce.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing our existing spreadsheets and understanding our current data structure and workflows

* Designing the appropriate Salesforce/Litify data architecture

* Mapping spreadsheet fields to Salesforce/Litify objects and fields

* Cleaning, standardizing, deduplicating, and preparing data for migration

* Importing and validating our existing data

* Configuring Salesforce/Litify objects, fields, permissions, layouts, and workflows

* Building Salesforce Flows and other automations

* Developing custom Salesforce functionality when required using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, etc.

* Integrating PhoneBurner with Salesforce/Litify

* Working with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and other integration technologies

* Ensuring call activity and relevant PhoneBurner data are properly captured inside Salesforce/Litify

* Troubleshooting synchronization and integration issues

* Creating appropriate sandbox/testing environments and testing changes before production deployment

* Documenting the system and customizations you build

* Training our team on the finished system

* Providing ongoing Salesforce/Litify development and support after implementation



Required Experience



We are specifically looking for someone with strong experience in:



* Salesforce development and administration

* Salesforce data migrations

* Large CSV/Excel/spreadsheet data imports

* Data mapping and data cleanup

* Salesforce Flow

* Apex

* SOQL

* Lightning / Lightning Web Components

* Salesforce REST APIs

* OAuth

* Webhooks and third-party API integrations

* Git/version control and proper deployment practices

* Building and maintaining production Salesforce environments



Strongly Preferred



Experience with any of the following will be a major advantage:



* Litify

* PhoneBurner

* Salesforce telephony/dialer integrations

* Legal industry CRM systems

* Salesforce managed packages

* High-volume lead/contact management

* Building custom Salesforce integrations



Direct Litify experience is highly preferred.



What Success Looks Like



The goal is to create a Salesforce/Litify environment that becomes the central system for our business.



Our existing spreadsheet data should be accurately migrated and organized, duplicate and inconsistent records should be addressed, and our team should be able to work primarily inside Salesforce/Litify rather than maintaining separate spreadsheets.



PhoneBurner should also work smoothly with the system so our team can efficiently call leads/contacts while keeping Salesforce/Litify records and call activity up to date.



Schedule



Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week, 



Exceptional candidates with significant Litify, Salesforce integration, and API development experience may be considered above this range.



This will initially be a major implementation project, with the opportunity for a long-term role maintaining and improving our Salesforce/Litify environment.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years have you worked with Salesforce?

2. Have you worked with Litify? If yes, please describe the project.

3. Have you completed a large Salesforce data migration? Approximately how many records were involved?

4. Describe a third-party API integration you personally built for Salesforce.

5. Have you worked with PhoneBurner or another Salesforce dialer/telephony platform?

6. What Salesforce certifications do you currently hold?

title: Promotional Products Sourcing & Project Coordinator (Promo, Swag, Branded Merch)
description:
Promotional Products Sourcing & Project Coordinator

Remote, Full-Time Contractor



South Sun Solutions is a branded merchandise company. We work with agencies, mission-driven brands, and corporate clients, and our positioning is simple: we translate moments, ideas, and initiatives into gifts that last. Most of our industry is catalog-and-logo. Our value is in creative origination, product judgment, and anticipating the details before they become problems so people receive items they keep. Sometimes that means designing something from scratch. Sometimes it means finding the right elevated object. And sometimes a client simply needs hats — done right, on time.



Sustainability, for us, means product longevity and material intentionality, not greenwashing. With that in mind, we’re also offering tech-enabled products that connect keepsake physical pieces with lasting digital experiences.



We’re a small team: two co-founders, plus a Strategic Account Manager (SAM) based in the Philippines. This role works directly with the SAM. It’s a full-time, long-term contractor role for someone who already knows the promotional products industry from the distributor side and wants to grow within a company that takes the work seriously and believes in consistency over intensity: some weeks have a heavier workload, some weeks are lighter; the goal is steady, high-quality execution over time, not constant urgency.





*What you’ll do*



In your first three months, your work centers on research, sourcing, and keeping our systems accurate and up to date.



~ Product research and sourcing support

・Research and recommend products against project requirements, with a focus on proactive projects and longer lead times

・Communicate with vendors on availability, pricing, and specs to prepare preliminary quotes

・Verify vendor payment details by phone before new or changed banking information is used — a standard fraud-prevention step we take whenever the timeline allows

・Keep ClickUp current so we have a truly robust project management system. This includes, but isn’t limited to: uploading all mockups to each project, linking
 threads to their corresponding projects, updating all quick-look fields, and maintaining the AR tracker. We plan to dedicate a knowledge transfer day to ClickUp during the onboarding phase.

・Set up the sync agenda doc for each call from our template — new doc, correct dates, labeled with the two-week span — at least a week ahead so everyone can add items as they come up

・Final product selection and project direction stay with the SAM. Rush projects stay with the SAM during this period.

・Other miscellaneous (but work-related) research and projects as they come up. For example: looking into freight forwarders, comparing options, and making recommendations; on an as-needed basis, following up with FedEx for international shipments that are held by customs



~ Client research

・Research clients and prospects from lists we provide, using LinkedIn, Google, our database, and whatever else works: upcoming events, programs, past purchases, and where a merch opportunity could exist (get creative!)

・Add to the prospect list when you spot a good opportunity

・Gather and organize what you find early enough for us to act on it — ideally, the team knows about upcoming events three or more months out, when possible



~ Product library and trend research

・Review vendor product suggestions (these typically arrive by
) and organize the products that look like a good fit for our clients into product libraries by category (apparel, hard goods, etc.)

・Separately, maintain running lists of new and trending products. These can come from supplier sites, trade show recaps, industry news, or anything else that catches your eye



~ Content and creative support

・Build and maintain a bank of ready-to-post LinkedIn assets showcasing completed projects, so there’s always something to pull from. This is an ongoing responsibility, not something you wait to be assigned. The SAM directs this work and is the first point of contact for any questions; if you need further context on a project or the client, the Executive Creative Director is your resource

・Create visual templates and simple social graphics in Canva

・Contribute content ideas and support initiatives that help people see our work





*What you won’t own*



We value transparency, so clear role definitions matter to us. The SAM owns final client communication, product selection, pricing and margin decisions, quote approval, project prioritization, major vendor decisions, and anything that requires judgment about the overall client relationship.



As Sourcing & Project Coordinator, you work alongside the SAM. When the SAM requests support with live client work, that comes first; the rest of your time goes to ongoing, mostly self-directed work like building product libraries and researching prospects. Your research, sourcing, and organization make the team’s work stronger and directly support the growth of the business.





*Where we see this role going*



After three months, if we both want to move forward together, the role expands to include the following, along with all previously listed work:



・Supporting all project types, including rush and time-sensitive work

・Responding to new inquiries and gathering initial project details (quantity, budget, timeline, product direction) before handing off to the SAM

・Flagging missing information, deadline risks, and opportunities, and more before they become problems or we’re too close to an event to pitch a client or proposal

・Building client-ready decks once product selection and direction are finalized

・Supporting concept-first outreach to target agencies and past clients (this will be explained!)

・Keeping our living documents current, especially upcoming client projects and events



Compensation grows with the role. The path we’re building toward is Coordinator → Senior Coordinator → Strategic Account Manager: growing into a second SAM role as the business grows.





*Who you’ll work with*



You’ll take day-to-day direction from our SAM. He sets your priorities, reviews your work, and is your first stop for questions about projects.



Our Executive Creative Director handles the personnel side: your onboarding, compensation, regular check-ins, and your 90-day evaluation. If something isn’t working — with your workload, how you’re being supported, or the working relationship itself — you can go to her directly.



You’ll join the company sync call every other week, and during your first 90 days you’ll have 1:1 check-ins with the Executive Creative Director on the weeks when there isn’t a sync call.





*What we’re looking for*



~ Required

・At least one year of experience at a promotional products distributor

・Working familiarity with Sage or ESP/ASI

・Experience with supplier portals (SanMar, alphabroder, or similar)

・Experience with a project management tool, and willingness to learn ClickUp

・Clear, professional English, spoken and written

・Comfortable working with direction, and comfortable working without it when the task calls for it — prospect research and product libraries are largely self-directed

・Available full-time during US Eastern business hours (roughly 9pm–6am Philippine time)



~ A plus

・Canva, Adobe, or other graphic design experience

・LinkedIn research experience

・University degree



~ And the things that matter more than any tool

Our clients expect higher-end pieces, and the question we start from isn’t “what do we put a logo on?” but “what object makes sense for this moment?”

・You’re curious about who’s receiving the item and why. You’ll research the brand and the event before suggesting what the object should be.

・You have an eye for quality. You can tell a basic item from an elevated one, and a “good-enough” item from the right one — and you’ll keep looking/reaching out until you find the vendor(s) who can make the right version.

・You notice what others miss — a material that’s off, a lead time that doesn’t actually work, a detail the client would catch (and you catch it before the client does!)

・You’re reliable. When you take on a responsibility, no matter how small the task, it gets done.

・You make educated guesses where possible (we love creative, independent thinking), and you ask when you’re unsure and/or when things are moving quickly. There are no stupid questions.

・You’re looking for a long-term role with growth, not a gig.





*Working structure and compensation*



・Full-time contractor role, 40 hours per week, fully remote

・US Eastern business hours

・$1,000 USD per month after the 90-day trial period, with a ramp over the first 90 days: $800 for Month 1, $850 for Month 2, $900 for Month 3, and $1,000 per month after the trial period ends

・A formal evaluation at 90 days, where we both d
 whether to move forward together

・Compensation grows from $1,000 per month with expanded responsibility and performance as the business grows. A more formal compensation document detailing compensation tied to growth milestones will be shared after the 90-day trial period if we move forward together





*How we work*



Five principles shape everything we do, including how we treat the people we work with:



・People over profit, while staying profitable

・Structure that serves everyone, not just the business

・Consistency over intensity

・Accountability as normal, not as punishment

・People as partners, not resources



If this sounds like how you want to work, please follow the directions below to apply. 





*How to apply*



Please start your application with the word LONGEVITY so we know you’ve read the full posting.



Then include:

・A short introduction (3–5 sentences)

・Why this role interests you

・One sourcing request you handled: what the client asked for, what you recommended, and what you’d do differently now, if anything

・Two suppliers you’ve worked with regularly, and one thing you learned about each (lead times, quality, service — whatever stood out)

・One process, system, or responsibility you fully owned, not assisted with

・Confirmation that you can work US Eastern business hours full-time





*What happens next*



We’ll review applications through September 25 and schedule first interviews the following week. Depending on how those go, we may invite a small number of candidates to a second conversation and/or a short paid sourcing exercise. Target start date is mid-October, though there is flexibility knowing we may need to work around a notice period.



We look forward to hearing from you!

About the Role



Bexley is looking for an experienced Short-Term Rental (STR) Operations Specialist to help manage our Airbnb portfolio and day-to-day guest operations.



We are looking for someone who understands how successful short-term rentals operate end-to-end and can take ownership of reservations, guest experience, property readiness, issue resolution, and coordination with our on-site team.



Our key platforms include Airbnb and Hospitable, so prior hands-on experience with these systems - particularly Hospitable - is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage Airbnb reservations and guest communications from inquiry through checkout

- Monitor and manage the portfolio through Hospitable

- Respond promptly and professionally to guest questions, requests, complaints, and emergencies

- Coordinate check-ins, checkouts, cleaning, maintenance, and property readiness with on-site team members

- Proactively identify upcoming stays and make sure units are ready before guest arrival

- Manage booking changes, cancellations, extensions, refunds, and other reservation issues

- Handle Airbnb guest disputes and support cases when necessary

- Monitor guest reviews and help maintain strong property ratings

- Maintain and improve Airbnb listings, including descriptions, amenities, house rules, photos/information, and availability

- Monitor occupancy, booking patterns, and basic STR performance metrics

- Identify operational issues and follow through until they are resolved

- Maintain clear records and escalate important issues to management

- Help develop and improve SOPs, automated messages, workflows, and other STR operating processes



What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has previously managed short-term rental properties and understands the operational details behind a good guest experience.



You should have:



- 5+ years of Airbnb / short-term rental management experience preferred

- Hands-on experience with Hospitable strongly preferred

- Strong familiarity with Airbnb's host platform, reservation management, guest messaging, reviews, and support processes

- Experience coordinating cleaners, maintenance teams, and other on-the-ground personnel remotely

- Excellent written English and ability to communicate professionally with U.S. guests

- Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple reservations and properties simultaneously

- Good judgment when handling guest complaints and d
 when an issue needs escalation

- A proactive mindset — we want someone who notices problems before guests do

- Reliable internet and ability to respond quickly to time-sensitive STR issues

- Experience with dynamic pricing/revenue management, Airbnb listing optimization, or STR performance reporting would be a plus.



What Success Looks Like



You will eventually become the team's go-to person for Bexley's short-term rental operations. Management should have clear visibility into upcoming stays and issues, guests should receive timely and professional support, and our on-site team should know exactly what needs to happen to keep properties guest-ready.



Over time, we would also like this person to help us improve occupancy, guest ratings, operating consistency, and the systems we use to manage our STR portfolio.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



- How many Airbnb/STR properties have you managed at one time?

- What exactly did you use Hospitable for in your previous role?

- Which other STR platforms or tools have you used?

- Describe one difficult guest situation you personally handled and how you resolved it.

- Have you coordinated cleaners and maintenance teams remotely? Please briefly describe your process.

- What U.S. hours are you available to work?



Please include the phrase “Bexley STR” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full posting.

title: Demand & Supply Planner – End-to-End Planning & MRP
description:
Who We Are



Starbond is a growing adhesive company committed to excellence, customer centricity, curiosity, humility, and continuous improvement. We sell through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B channels and are strengthening our supply chain planning capabilities to support reliable product availability and scalable growth.



The Role



Starbond is seeking a highly analytical and proactive Demand & Supply Planner with at least five years of hands-on experience across the complete planning cycle: demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory optimization, material requirements planning (MRP), and production planning.



This role owns planning from end to end. You will develop a reliable consensus demand forecast, convert it into inventory and material requirements, and create executable purchasing, production, and distribution plans. You will monitor actual performance, identify changes and risks, and continuously revise the plan based on new information.



This is not a role for someone who has only maintained an existing planning system. The successful candidate must also be able to build, audit, and improve an Excel-based planning and MRP tool from the ground up. You will connect channel forecasts, bills of materials, inventory, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, capacity, and production requirements into one dependable planning process.



The ideal candidate combines strong technical planning knowledge with excellent judgment, emotional intelligence, ownership, and proactive communication. You should be comfortable identifying weak assumptions, explaining risks clearly, and recommending practical improvements rather than waiting for detailed instructions.



Key Responsibilities



Demand Planning and Forecast Ownership

Own the SKU- and channel-level demand forecast across Amazon, Shopify, and B2B.

Develop rolling forecasts using sales history, seasonality, promotions, customer commitments, product life cycles, channel plans, market intelligence, and future business assumptions.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to gather forecast inputs, challenge assumptions, resolve differences, and establish a documented consensus demand plan.

Separate baseline demand from promotional, event-driven, new-product, and one-time demand.

Track forecast accuracy and bias by SKU and channel, investigate material variances, and improve forecasting methods over time.

Maintain documented forecast assumptions, risks, opportunities, scenarios, and version history.

Identify demand changes early and clearly communicate their expected impact on inventory, purchasing, production, capacity, and cash flow.



Supply and Inventory Planning

Translate the approved demand forecast into time-phased inventory, purchasing, production, and distribution requirements.

Establish and maintain SKU-level reorder points, safety stock, order quantities, and inventory targets.

Apply appropriate safety-stock methods using desired service levels, demand variability, lead-time variability, and supplier reliability.

Monitor stockout risks, excess inventory, slow-moving products, inventory turnover, forecast accuracy, and service levels.

Create constrained and unconstrained supply plans and identify where supplier, material, capacity, cash, or storage limitations prevent the business from meeting demand.

Recommend prioritized actions that balance customer service, inventory investment, operating cost, and business risk.



MRP and Excel Tool Development

Build, maintain, audit, and improve an Excel-based MRP and replenishment system.

Integrate core planning data, including the SKU master, sales forecast, stock on hand, open purchase orders, supplier lead times, bills of materials, and purchasing recommendations.

Create reliable formulas, data-validation controls, exception flags, dashboards, and scenario models that make the tool accurate, understandable, and easy to maintain.

Identify broken links, duplicated data, manual work, weak assumptions, and opportunities for automation.

Document planning logic, data sources, ownership, update frequency, and standard operating procedures.



BOM, Materials, and Production Planning

Perform BOM explosion by converting finished-goods demand into component, packaging, and raw-material requirements.

Account for existing component inventory, open orders, lead times, minimum order quantities, yields, scrap, and production constraints.

Translate material availability and demand requirements into practical production schedules.

Identify material shortages, capacity conflicts, and timing risks early and recommend feasible solutions.

Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, suppliers, and warehouse partners to align purchase and production plans.



Supply Planning and Risk Management

Evaluate supplier performance, including actual versus quoted lead times, delivery reliability, quality issues, and supply variability.

Recommend safety-stock adjustments, order timing, secondary sourcing, or other mitigation measures based on quantified risk.

Develop supply scenarios for demand changes, supplier delays, promotions, new-product launches, and capacity limitations.

Ensure planning recommendations balance product availability, working capital, storage constraints, and operational cost.



S&OP, Reporting, and Cross-Functional Communication

Provide concise planning updates that clearly identify risks, business impact, recommended actions, responsible owners, and deadlines.

Lead or support a structured monthly S&OP planning cycle connecting demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and financial considerations.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Operations, and leadership to reconcile forecasts with supply capabilities and business priorities.

Present S&OP scenarios, gaps, tradeoffs, assumptions, and recommendations to decision-makers.

Document agreed decisions and ensure changes flow into the demand forecast, supply plan, purchasing plan, and production schedule.

Communicate proactively when information is incomplete, assumptions change, or a plan is at risk.



Required Qualifications



At least five years of hands-on experience covering both demand planning and supply planning, including inventory, materials, or production planning.

Demonstrated ownership of a rolling SKU-level forecast and the ability to translate it into an executable supply plan.

Strong understanding of forecasting methods, seasonality, promotions, forecast accuracy, forecast bias, consensus planning, and scenario analysis.

Demonstrated experience building or substantially redesigning an MRP, inventory-planning, or replenishment tool in Excel.

Strong knowledge of reorder-point logic, safety-stock modeling, lead-time variability, service levels, and inventory optimization.

Practical experience with BOM explosion and raw-material or component planning.

Advanced Excel skills, including structured tables, XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, PivotTables, conditional logic, data validation, error controls, and scenario modeling.

Experience translating forecasts into purchase and production requirements.

Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong ownership, emotional intelligence, attention to detail, and proactive communication.

Availability to work a full-time schedule aligned with Pacific Time.

title: Procurement Specialist (experience with US and Asian suppliers required)
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a U.S.-based manufacturer and eCommerce company specializing in high-performance adhesives and industrial products. We serve customers through Amazon, Shopify, and B2B distribution channels across multiple global markets.



We are looking for a Procurement Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building supplier relationships, negotiating favorable commercial terms, solving supply chain challenges, and continuously improving procurement operations. This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, proactive, highly organized, and comfortable working with suppliers across multiple countries and cultures.







Position Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing and managing suppliers across the United States and Asia, negotiating pricing and commercial terms, evaluating supplier capabilities, and ensuring a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials.



This role plays a critical part in protecting supply continuity, reducing procurement costs, supporting contract manufacturing initiatives, and ensuring Starbond maintains a diversified supplier network that supports long-term business growth.



Key Responsibilities



Strategic Sourcing

Source, evaluate, and qualify suppliers across the United States and Asia.

Conduct supplier research, RFQs, quotation comparisons, and supplier evaluations.

Develop and maintain qualified primary and backup suppliers for critical materials.

Identify new sourcing opportunities that improve cost, quality, and supply continuity.

Support contract manufacturer and third-party logistics (3PL) sourcing initiatives.

Verify supplier capabilities, certifications, and compliance requirements.



Supplier Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers.

Monitor supplier responsiveness, lead times, pricing, and overall performance.

Conduct supplier performance reviews and maintain supplier scorecards.

Coordinate corrective actions when supplier performance issues arise.

Work closely with suppliers to resolve procurement challenges and minimize operational disruptions.



Cost Optimization

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and commercial agreements.

Analyze supplier quotations and landed costs.

Benchmark supplier pricing and market conditions.

Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and supply reliability.

Recommend sourcing strategies that improve overall profitability.



Procurement Operations

Maintain accurate supplier records and procurement databases.

Support purchase order creation and supplier follow-ups.

Keep supplier pricing, lead times, MOQs, and procurement data up to date.

Organize procurement documentation and sourcing records.

Ensure procurement information is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement

Prepare procurement reports and sourcing updates.

Maintain procurement dashboards and tracking tools.

Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes and documentation.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and supply chain operations.

Proactively identify supply risks and recommend mitigation strategies.





Qualifications



Required

Minimum 3 years of experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain.

Hands-on experience working with both U.S. and Asian suppliers (China, Taiwan, Vietnam, India, or other APAC countries).

Proven experience sourcing, qualifying, and negotiating with international suppliers.

Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.

Excellent analytical and cost analysis abilities.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.



Preferred

Experience working with contract manufacturers or OEM/ODM suppliers.

Experience supporting manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, or eCommerce businesses.

Familiarity with ERP, MRP, or procurement management systems.

Experience analyzing supplier performance metrics and procurement KPIs.





What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is someone who:

Takes ownership and follows through without constant supervision.

Builds strong supplier relationships while negotiating effectively.

Thinks strategically and solves problems proactively.

Communicates clearly and escalates risks early.

Makes data-driven decisions rather than assumptions.

Continuously looks for opportunities to improve procurement processes.

Is highly organized and detail-oriented.

Can comfortably work with suppliers across different countries, cultures, and time zones.

title: Mobile App Developer Needed — Interactive Kids Virtual Pet / Adventure App
description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW:



I am looking for an experienced mobile app developer or small development team to build a highly interactive children's mobile app for iOS and Android.



The app combines:



• A virtual pet companion

• Interactive daily activities

• Voice interaction

• Mini-games

• Rewards and collectible items

• Pet care

• Character progression/evolution

• Fantasy challenges

• Multiple unlockable environments

• Bedtime stories

• Parent dashboard

• AI-powered features



This is NOT a simple educational app with static screens.



The goal is to create something that feels like a polished children's game where the character reacts constantly to what the child does.



The child should be tapping, dragging, speaking, choosing, helping, collecting, exploring and interacting with their character throughout the experience.



I already have extensive concept art, UI references, character ideas, gameplay concepts and screen flows.



The selected developer will receive the deeper product specification after selection and NDA.



--------------------------------------------------



CORE FEATURES



1. CHILD ONBOARDING



The app begins with a polished onboarding experience where the child:



• Enters/selects their name

• Chooses a character/pet

• Meets their companion

• Completes a short interactive introduction

• Enters the main game environment



The onboarding should feel animated and magical rather than like filling out forms.



------------------------------------------
. VIRTUAL PET SYSTEM



The child has their own interactive pet/companion.



The pet should:



• Blink

• Move

• Celebrate

• Sleep

• Eat

• Drink

• Play

• React emotionally

• Respond to activities

• Grow/evolve over time



The pet should feel alive.



Static character images alone will not be enough.



------------------------------------------
. MAIN INTERACTIVE HUB



Instead of a standard menu, children enter a fantasy environment containing different interactive locations.



Examples:



• Pet home

• Activity areas

• Games

• Story area

• Drawing area

• Challenges

• Collectibles

• Locked areas

• Future environments



The child taps different parts of the environment to enter activities.



------------------------------------------
. DAILY ACTIVITIES



The app will include rotating daily tasks and interactive missions.



Tasks can include:



• Helping someone

• Sharing

• Cleaning

• Listening

• Completing a simple challenge

• Speaking certain phrases

• Drawing

• Taking care of their pet



The app should react differently depending on the child's response.



Example:



The character asks the child a question.



The child answers YES or NOT YET.



If NOT YET, the character may encourage them to complete the activity and come back.



------------------------------------------
. VOICE INTERACTION



Several parts of the app require the child to speak.



Eventually the app should support speech recognition so certain words or phrases can be detected.



As words are spoken correctly, they may visually:



• Light up

• Become underlined

• Glow

• Trigger animations

• Advance progress



Experience integrating speech recognition is a major plus.



------------------------------------------
. REWARD SYSTEM



Completing activities earns rewards.



Possible rewards:



• Toys

• Badges

• Stars

• Character XP

• Decorations

• Collectibles

• New animations

• New areas

• Character upgrades



After certain tasks, the child may choose between several rewards.



------------------------------------------
. TOY COLLECTION



The child's pet can collect toys.



The child can:



• Choose toys

• Give toys to the pet

• View the collection

• Watch the pet interact with toys

• Unlock rarer items



Different toys should trigger different animations.



------------------------------------------
. PET HOME



The pet has its own home.



The child can enter it and interact with the pet.



Activities may include:



• Feeding

• Giving water

• Playing

• Cleaning

• Bathing

• Bedtime

• Organizing the room

• Toy collection



This area should feel like a virtual-pet game.



------------------------------------------
. DRAG-AND-DROP MINI-GAMES



Several activities involve direct touch interaction.



Examples:



• Dragging toys to different characters

• Cleaning a room

• Sorting objects

• Moving items to correct locations

• Giving an object to the pet

• Completing simple touch-based puzzles



Strong drag-and-drop UX is important.



------------------------------------------
. CHARACTER CHALLENGES / BATTLES



The app will include fantasy challenge sequences.



These should feel cinematic and game-like.



The child's pet may face larger fantasy characters/creatures.



The child completes voice or interaction challenges to reduce the opponent's power and complete the encounter.



The system should be reusable so many different challenges can be created using one engine.



------------------------------------------
. CHARACTER PROGRESSION



The pet grows and changes visually as the child progresses.



Eventually there may be multiple evolution stages.



Progression can unlock:



• New appearance

• New effects

• New abilities

• New animations

• New areas

• Stronger challenge abilities



------------------------------------------
. MULTIPLE ENVIRONMENTS



The app architecture should support multiple fantasy environments/worlds over time.



Each environment may contain:



• Different artwork

• Activities

• Challenges

• Characters

• Rewards

• Collectibles

• Final challenge

• Unlock progression



Do NOT hard-code every world separately.



The system should be scalable and data-driven.



------------------------------------------
. DRAWING ACTIVITY



The child can participate in creative drawing activities.



Eventually this may support:



• Built-in drawing

• Parent-assisted camera capture

• AI-assisted image recognition

• Positive character feedback



The experience should always be encouraging.



------------------------------------------
. BEDTIME MODE



The app will contain a calmer nighttime experience.



The child can:



• Help put the pet to bed

• Select a story

• Listen to narrated content

• Complete simple breathing exercises

• Watch calming animations



The app will launch with multiple bedtime stories and should allow new stories to be added later without rebuilding the app.



------------------------------------------
. GUIDED CALMING ACTIVITIES



There may be short audio/visual activities such as:



• Breathing exercises

• Relaxation activities

• Simple guided listening experiences



These should feel integrated into the game rather than like a clinical health app.



------------------------------------------
. AI CHARACTER CONVERSATION



A future/premium feature may allow the child to talk to their pet using AI.



The character should:



• Understand simple child speech

• Respond briefly

• Remain age appropriate

• Maintain personality

• Follow strict child-safety rules



This feature will require significant safety and parental-control architecture.



Experience with OpenAI/LLM APIs, moderation and child-safe AI systems is a major plus.



------------------------------------------
. CAMERA-BASED MINI-GAMES



Future versions may include optional camera interaction with parental permission.



For example:



• Smile-based challenges

• Simple facial movement games

• AR-style interactions



This should NOT be designed as medical or psychological emotion detection.



------------------------------------------
. PARENT DASHBOARD



There will be a completely separate parent-only section.



Parents may eventually see:



• Activities completed

• Rewards earned

• Character progress

• Stories listened to

• Badges

• Usage summary

• Child profiles

• Privacy settings

• Camera permissions

• Microphone permissions

• AI settings

• Content settings



The parent area must be protected by a parental gate.



------------------------------------------
. CHILD PRIVACY AND SAFETY



This app is intended for young children.



Child safety and privacy are extremely important.



The developer should understand or be willing to carefully implement:



• COPPA requirements

• Apple Kids Category requirements

• Google Play Families requirements

• Parental consent

• Child-data minimization

• Secure storage

• Camera/microphone permissions

• Safe analytics

• Appropriate parental gates



There will be:



• No public child profiles

• No stranger messaging

• No unrestricted child-to-child chat

• No public ranking of identifiable children



--------------------------------------------------



TECHNICAL DIRECTION



I am open to technical recommendations.



My current preferred direction is:



• React Native

• Expo

• TypeScript

• iOS + Android from one codebase



Potential backend:



• Supabase

or

• Firebase



Future integrations may include:



• Speech recognition

• Text-to-speech

• AI APIs

• Camera/vision

• Audio

• Subscriptions

• Analytics

• Push notifications



Animation experience with any of the following is a major plus:



• Rive

• Lottie

• React Native Reanimated

• Spine

• Similar game-animation technology



--------------------------------------------------



IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT REQUIREMENT



I do NOT want someone to simply create 100+ completely separate hard-coded screens.



The application needs reusable systems.



For example:



One activity engine should support many activities.



One challenge/battle system should support many different characters.



One story player should support many stories.



One reward system should support many reward types.



One pet-care system should support multiple actions.



The application needs to be scalable because much more content will be added after launch.



--------------------------------------------------



DESIGN STYLE



I already have visual concepts.



The final product should feel:



• Premium

• Magical

• Highly animated

• Colorful

• Warm

• Child friendly

• Game-like

• Modern

• Polished

title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

title: Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager
description:
Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager

The People’s Nurse | Living Your Life Without Limits

Full-Time Remote Position | 40 Hours Per Week | International Candidates Welcome



About Us

Living Your Life Without Limits (LYLWL) is a nurse-led health, wellness, education, leadership, and consulting company founded by Shannon Jackson, RN — The People’s Nurse.



Our brand is built around three core principles:

Motivation. Education. Inspiration.



With more than 30 years of nursing, healthcare leadership, consulting, education, entrepreneurship, and community engagement, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth.



Our goal is to expand The People’s Nurse into a stronger, recognizable health, wellness, fitness, education, motivational, speaking, and corporate brand—while continuing to grow Living Your Life Without Limits.



We are seeking an experienced Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager who can help us turn that vision into strategy, opportunities, partnerships, programs, visibility, and measurable revenue growth.



This Is NOT Simply a Social Media Position

We already have support for social media and marketing.

We are not looking for someone whose primary responsibility is simply creating posts, scheduling content, or maintaining a content calendar.



We are looking for a builder.

We need someone who can look at an established professional brand, recognize its untapped potential, identify the right audiences and opportunities, and help turn more than three decades of experience and expertise into a larger platform.



The right person should be able to think:

What do we already have?

Who needs it?

How should we package it?

Who should we approach?

How can we monetize it?

And how do we execute it?



What We Want to Build

You will help expand The People’s Nurse and Living Your Life Without Limits across opportunities including:

•	Health, wellness, and fitness education

•	Motivational and inspirational programs

•	Corporate and employee wellness

•	Healthcare education

•	Leadership and professional development

•	Speaking engagements

•	Conferences and workshops

•	Community health initiatives

•	Virtual and in-person events

•	Courses and educational programs

•	Wellness challenges and campaigns

•	Podcasts and guest appearances

•	Media and expert opportunities

•	Brand collaborations

•	Sponsorship opportunities

•	Strategic partnerships

•	Digital products and scalable programs



Our goal is not simply to produce more content.

Our goal is to build a trusted, impactful, recognizable, and revenue-generating brand.



Key Responsibilities

The Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager will work directly with Shannon and collaborate with the existing team to:

•	Develop and execute a strategic growth plan for The People’s Nurse and Living Your Life Without Limits.

•	Evaluate our existing brand, programs, expertise, and resources to identify new growth opportunities.

•	Help strengthen the brand's foundation in Motivation, Education, Inspiration, Health, Wellness, and Fitness.

•	Identify corporations, healthcare organizations, associations, conferences, nonprofits, community organizations, and other groups that align with our services and mission.

•	Research and pursue speaking engagements, conferences, workshops, podcasts, media appearances, and guest-expert opportunities.

•	Identify corporate wellness and employee education opportunities.

•	Develop strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities.

•	Research appropriate sponsorship and brand partnership opportunities.

•	Help package existing knowledge and expertise into marketable workshops, courses, wellness programs, challenges, educational products, and other scalable offerings.

•	Identify opportunities to monetize existing and future intellectual property.

•	Develop professional outreach campaigns and conduct consistent follow-up with prospective partners and organizations.

•	Build relationships that can lead to contracts, speaking engagements, collaborations, programs, and revenue.

•	Work with the marketing/social media team so content supports the larger brand and business-growth strategy.

•	Identify opportunities to repurpose existing presentations, educational materials, videos, training, and other content.

•	Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, partnerships, speaking opportunities, programs, outreach, deadlines, and results.

•	Provide weekly updates identifying actions taken, opportunities generated, follow-up required, barriers, and measurable results.

•	Bring new ideas and opportunities to leadership rather than waiting for daily assignments.



Who We Are Looking For

We want someone who combines creativity with business strategy and execution.

You understand that building a successful personal and professional brand involves much more than increasing followers.

It requires strong positioning, strategic relationships, compelling programs, partnerships, speaking opportunities, community impact, corporate relationships, consistent visibility, and sustainable revenue.

You should be comfortable taking an idea from:

Concept → Strategy → Outreach → Opportunity → Execution → Results



Preferred Qualifications

Candidates should have demonstrated experience in several of the following:

•	Brand development and growth strategy

•	Personal brand development

•	Business development

•	Strategic partnerships

•	Corporate partnerships

•	Health, wellness, or fitness brands

•	Speaker development or speaker outreach

•	Corporate wellness

•	Public relations or media outreach

•	Course or program development

•	Digital product development

•	Sponsorship development

•	Lead generation

•	Relationship management

•	Marketing strategy

•	Revenue development



Experience working with healthcare professionals, nurses, executives, speakers, coaches, educators, wellness professionals, authors, entrepreneurs, or personal brands is highly desirable.



Candidates must also have:

•	Strong research and strategic-thinking skills

•	Excellent written and verbal English communication

•	Strong organization and follow-through

•	Ability to work independently

•	Ability to manage multiple opportunities and deadlines

•	Confidence communicating professionally with U.S.-based organizations and executives

•	Initiative and the ability to bring solutions—not simply identify problems



This is not an entry-level position.



What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90–180 days, the successful candidate should help establish:

•	A clear growth roadmap for The People’s Nurse

•	Defined target audiences and markets

•	A stronger health, wellness, and fitness growth strategy

•	A pipeline of qualified speaking opportunities

•	Corporate wellness prospects

•	Strategic partnership prospects

•	Podcast, media, and expert opportunities

•	New program and course concepts

•	Potential sponsorship and collaboration opportunities

•	Consistent professional outreach and follow-up

•	A system for tracking opportunities from initial contact through conversion

•	Measurable opportunities for increased visibility and revenue



We are looking for results—not simply activity.



Compensation & Benefits

•	Full-Time Remote Position

•	40 Hours Per Week

•	Starting Rate: $10.00 USD Per Hour

•	Performance Review After 6 Months

•	Opportunity for Compensation Increase Based on Performance

•	13th-Month Pay

•	Paid Vacation Time

•	Professional Development Opportunities

•	Long-Term Career Growth Potential



How to Apply

Please submit the following to 
 your application with “Brand Growth & Strategic Partnerships Manager” to confirm you have carefully reviewed the position requirements.



1.	Resume

2.	Cover letter

3.	Three professional references

Living Your Life Without Limits

The People’s Nurse

Motivation. Education. Inspiration.

As part of an early-stage company, you'll have a lot of ownership in the role. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, work independently, make decisions, and take things and run with them.

description:
PH - Media Buyer Specialist



We're looking for a Media Buyer Specialist to own the performance and impact of a large book of complex, custom paid media campaigns for our practices — leading strategy, setup, optimization, and communication with practices and cross-functional teams to get results.



You'll also be stepping into using AI as leverage — scaling both the quality and volume of your work by recognizing patterns, making good bets, and playing to exploit every advantage, rather than relying on automated platforms or SOPs to do the thinking for you.



Ad buying is changing fast. This role exists for someone who understands data, tracking, and the full funnel deeply enough to know when to follow our best practices and when to trust their own judgment — and who's ready to own the outcome either way. Getting this right lets the rest of our media team focus on their own work instead of constantly course-correcting an underperforming book.



Our objectives for the role

- Own the performance of a large, complex book of campaigns, around 50 initially and scales up with time — from strategy and setup through optimization — and be accountable for the outcome, whether you followed our playbooks or your own judgment to get there.

- Build deep command of our reporting and tracking systems so you can pull your own data, diagnose account health quickly and accurately, and manage risk proactively before it shows up in results.

- Use AI as leverage to run more accounts at a higher level — treating media buying as a competitive game of pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven testing, and educated bets – to drive results you’ll own.

- Contribute best practices and workflows — like a new setup approach or AI-assisted process — that get adopted as standard team practice.

- Use your understanding of the full funnel we deploy and your excellent communication skills to influence clients and cross-functional teams towards better performance for the campaigns you own.



We're looking for:

- Ownership and accountability — you take full responsibility for a large book of accounts' results, regardless of whether you followed an SOP or your own judgment to get there.

- Autonomy and judgment — you know when to lean on established playbooks and when to deviate, and you're comfortable making that call independently.

- Optimization and testing rigor — you approach media buying like a competitive game: pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven tests, and educated bets, not guesswork.

- Tracking and reporting command — you can pull your own data and diagnose account and tracking health quickly, without waiting on someone else to hand you a report.

- Productive use of AI — you use AI to scale the volume and quality of your work, but you don't let it replace your own judgment on what actually moves the needle.



Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- This is a role built for media buyers who want to own outcomes, not just execute tickets — full autonomy over a book of accounts, real say in when to follow SOPs versus your own judgment, and credit for the results either way.

- It's an IC track with real influence: your work shapes team playbooks and best practices, without requiring you to manage people to get that influence.

- You'll work within a high-caliber team where iron sharpens iron — challenging, fast-paced, and genuinely fun if you like this game.

- Competitive salary

title: Paid Media Creative Specialist (PH)
description:
PH - Paid Media Creative Specialist



We're looking for a PH - Marketing Creative Specialist to own the creative outcomes for paid social campaigns — concepts, iterations, and final static and video deliverables — directly driving the metrics (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) that determine campaign performance, while also making ads that are beautiful and delight our clients.



You'll also be stepping into building and owning AI-augmented creative workflows — using AI as leverage to increase the volume and quality of what you ship, without letting it replace your own trend instincts and creative judgment.



We’re looking for a creative who loves Meta - who lives and breathes Instagram. And who is obsessed with what makes content convert - both organically and in paid ads. You’ll get the autonomy and creative freedom to make amazing designs - and the responsibility for how those perform, and more importantly, using how they perform to improve what we make next. Done well, you’ll help us build creative capability that not just delights our clients, but delivers on ROI and growth.



Our objectives for the role

- Ship creatives that delight our practices: creatives that highlight what’s best about their practices, results, and branding – and that they’re so excited about that they regularly ask us if they can post our ads as organic content on their feeds, too.

- Own creative performance (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) across your designs – and turn patterns of performance into meaningful insights and repeatable elements or frameworks that get actioned in feedback loops into your work and the broader team.

- Spot trends and micro-trends and translate them into on-brand, executable static and video creatives – that appeal to the right audiences and pain points for a given campaign.

- Demonstrate command of production tools, specs, file setup, and platform requirements across Meta placements, and become a go-to resource on specs and complex production issues (compression, accessibility, delivery).

- Contribute to AI-driven creative workflows and frameworks — for concepting, production, or testing — that get adopted across the broader creative team.

- Scale a creative process or workflow into standard team practice, and act as a subject-matter expert whose creative-performance patterns guide the rest of the team.



We're looking for:

- Top Tier Aesthetic Taste — you know the exact layouts, fonts, music, and styling that will make creative pop. You can design for multiple aesthetics and never ship a boring or basic creative.

- Creative ownership and execution — you can spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work across both static and video, within provided frameworks, not just execute someone else's brief. This includes writing the copy and executing the design work, on-brand, and owning its performance in the ad platforms.

- Performance fluency — you're fluent in performance creative and think in terms of the metrics that matter: CTR, hook rate, cost per result, and ultimately, ROI.

- Turn Patterns into Systems — you see the hook that performs in every video ad you ship as a repeatable element you should mix into every new video we script, and that one red button that always makes a graphic’s cost per lead lower as your ace in your back pocket for accounts whose creative just doesn’t hit. And you’re ready to take this skill further into templates that de-risk creative performance, using insights from across a portfolio of brands running similar ads.

- Production mastery — deep command of specs, file setup,editing/creating tools (including AI augmentation), and platform requirements, with the ability to independently resolve production issues that stump others.

- Trend fluency — you already think like a trend-setter; spotting what's next is a skill you own, not something you outsource to an algorithm.

- Productive use of AI — you build and own AI-augmented workflows, using AI as leverage rather than a crutch or a replacement for your judgment. Ads and creatives that are obviously AI give you the ick - and you would never give us a final product that looks like Claude, or Chat, or some other AI tool’s basic output - even though you probably did use them to help you execute it.



Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- This role is built for a creative who wants real ownership — not just execution against someone else's brief, but the ability to spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work, across both static and video.

- It's a high-autonomy, high-trust role with a clear growth path toward creative leadership, working at the frontier of AI-augmented creative production without being replaced by it.

- Competitive salary

title: Video Editor + Creative VA for Spreadsheet Template Business (YouTube, Pinterest, Canva) — Part-Time, Weekly Tasks
description:
Job Overview



Hi! I run TopSheets, a growing digital product business selling spreadsheet templates (Google Sheets + Excel) on Etsy and my own website. I'm looking for ONE reliable, detail-oriented VA to become my long-term creative right hand.



Right now, the biggest project is editing my catalog of YouTube tutorial videos. Alongside and beyond that, you'll create short-form social media content (reels/TikToks), Pinterest pins, and Canva listing mockups — the ongoing creative work that keeps the business running and growing.



This is a part-time role (roughly 10–15 hours/week) built around a weekly task list — I send you the list at the start of the week, you deliver by the end of the week. You choose your own hours. No time tracking, no fixed schedule. I care about finished work, not hours online.



What You'll Do



YouTube tutorial editing (current big project):



Edit screen-recording tutorial videos (8–20 min finished). I provide a rough cut with the audio, screen recording, and talking-head footage already synced and mistakes removed. You make it YouTube-ready: zoom-ins and highlight callouts on the cells/formulas being discussed, pacing polish, text overlays

Clean, simple editing style — NO flashy transitions, NO MrBeast-style effects. Think calm, clear, helpful

Cut 1–2 vertical Shorts from each tutorial

I handle thumbnails, descriptions, and publishing myself — your job ends at the finished export



Pinterest:



Design pins in Canva using my brand templates (static + video pins)

Deliver a set number of finished pins each week — I handle scheduling and descriptions myself



Canva / Listings:



Upgrade/create listing image sets for Etsy and my website (device mockups, feature slides)

Adapt existing graphics for German, Spanish, and French editions (I provide translations)

Cut short looping preview videos for Etsy listings



Social media content (growing part of the role):



Create short-form reels/TikToks showing our templates in use — aesthetic, satisfying, planner-community style content

I provide the screen recordings and brand kit; you bring the editing and the eye

As the tutorial catalog wraps up, this becomes a bigger share of the weekly list



Requirements



Proven video editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar) — portfolio required

Comfortable in Canva

Strong written English

Reliable internet and a computer that can edit 1080p video smoothly

Organized: consistent file naming, uses Google Drive, communicates proactively when something is unclear or delayed

Bonus (not required): experience with Pinterest graphics or planner/stationery-niche content



Pay & Process



Paid trial week: I will hire 3 candidates for a one-week paid trial ($50 flat). Everyone gets the same task list and the same raw footage. One person gets the ongoing role.

Ongoing: flat weekly rate of $75/week for approximately 10–15 hours of tasks, paid weekly via [Wise/PayPal/Payoneer]. Workload flexes week to week and balances out.

Long-term role. I'm building this business for years, and I want someone who grows with it.



How to Apply



Start your application with the word PIVOT so I know you read this posting.

Link 3–5 examples of videos you've edited. At least one should be a tutorial, screen-recording, or explainer-style video if you have one. Tell me in one line what YOU did on each (edited only? added graphics? full production?).

Link 1–2 examples of short-form vertical content you've made (Reels, TikToks, or Shorts). If you don't have any yet, say so honestly — but examples are a big plus.

If you have Canva design work (pins, social graphics, product images), link a portfolio or 2–3 examples.

In 2–3 sentences, tell me: what's one thing that makes a tutorial video easy to follow?

Link one Instagram or TikTok account (any brand) whose short-form content style you love, and tell me in one sentence why.

Tell me your experience level with Canva and Pinterest (it's okay if it's beginner — just be honest).



Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered. Thanks, and I'm excited to meet you!
