title: Marketing Manager
description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a growing direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering high-quality products and an excellent customer experience. We are looking for a hands-on Marketing Manager who can turn data, customer insights, and strong execution into profitable growth.



About the Role

The Marketing Manager will own Starbond’s direct-to-consumer growth engine across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), social media, conversion optimization, and agency performance. This role requires a strong command of unit economics—including customer lifetime value (LTV), customer acquisition cost (CAC), CAC payback period, gross margin, and contribution margin—and the ability to convert these metrics into sound growth decisions.



You will directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO while leading the internal Marketing team, setting clear performance standards, and giving the CEO timely visibility into results, risks, and recommended actions.



Key Responsibilities



DTC Growth and Customer Acquisition

Develop and lead the DTC acquisition strategy across Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, email, SEO, social media, Amazon alignment, and other relevant channels.

Manage marketing for profitable growth—not revenue or ROAS alone—by incorporating product margin, contribution margin, retention, and customer quality into decisions.

Establish acceptable CAC thresholds by product, customer segment, campaign, and channel, and recommend when to scale, restructure, reduce, or discontinue investment.

Align advertising, creative, landing pages, offers, product positioning, inventory availability, and operational readiness.



LTV, Retention, and Lifecycle Marketing

Maintain a clear and consistent LTV methodology using customer revenue, purchase frequency, retention, gross margin or contribution margin, and cohort data.

Analyze LTV and retention by acquisition source, product, cohort, and customer segment, and use the findings to improve channel and offer decisions.

Lead strategies that improve repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency, average order value, cross-sell, replenishment, retention, and win-back performance.

Oversee email and lifecycle marketing quality, segmentation, deliverability, revenue contribution, and customer communication accuracy.



Paid Advertising and Conversion

Oversee paid media strategy, budget pacing, campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, attribution, and landing-page performance.

Establish clear testing, scaling, optimization, and stop-loss rules, and require decisions to be supported by sufficient data and financial context.

Review performance at the channel, campaign, audience, creative, product, and cohort levels.

Partner with the Web Developer on Shopify priorities, site performance, conversion rate optimization, tracking, and quality assurance.



Agency and Vendor Management

Directly manage marketing agencies across Meta, Google, email, and AEO, including scopes of work, deliverables, timelines, communication standards, SLAs, KPIs, reporting, ownership, and escalation procedures.

Use agency scorecards and recurring performance reviews to track KPI attainment, SLA compliance, output quality, timeliness, efficiency, and business results.

Require root-cause analysis and time-bound corrective action plans for missed targets, SLA breaches, quality issues, reporting gaps, or inefficient spend.

Independently validate agency recommendations and recommend contract expansion, renegotiation, reduction, replacement, or termination when appropriate.

Ensure Starbond retains access to and ownership of advertising accounts, data, dashboards, creative files, documentation, and intellectual property.



Content, Creative, and Brand

Maintain an active content and creative pipeline supported by clear briefs, owners, deadlines, QA standards, and success metrics.

Ensure reliable content-production support is available when external resources are required.

Create a structured process for testing creative concepts, hooks, formats, messages, offers, and calls to action.

Protect product positioning and perceived value by avoiding excessive reliance on discounting and ensuring marketing claims are accurate and supportable.

Ensure approved assets are properly named, organized, and stored in company-owned systems.



Team Leadership, Process, and Reporting

Lead the internal Marketing team by setting clear responsibilities, deadlines, quality standards, KPIs, communication expectations, and individual performance targets.

Conduct regular coaching, one-on-ones, performance reviews, and accountability conversations; identify skill gaps and coordinate development or corrective action with HR.

Make timely recommendations regarding training, role clarity, workload changes, reassignment, or other performance actions when standards are not met.

Create and maintain marketing processes, approval flows, reporting definitions, campaign documentation, and quality-control systems.

Maintain a weekly marketing scorecard that distinguishes leading and lagging indicators and explains what changed, why it changed, and what action is required.

Proactively escalate material risks and present concise, financially grounded recommendations to the CEO.



What Success Looks Like



Marketing data, forecasts, campaign reports, creative briefs, and recommendations are accurate, validated, and financially grounded.

Campaigns, agency deliverables, reports, corrective actions, and launches are completed on time, with blockers escalated early.

CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, and cohort performance are consistently defined and used to guide decisions.

Marketing investment produces profitable customer growth, stronger retention, faster learning, higher-quality execution, and stronger brand protection.

The Marketing team and external agencies operate with clear ownership, measurable standards, and consistent accountability.



What We’re Looking For



Proven experience leading DTC or e-commerce marketing across paid acquisition, retention, lifecycle marketing, content, and conversion optimization.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, retention, cohort analysis, and marketing attribution.

Experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, email marketing, SEO, AEO, Shopify, and agency partners.

Demonstrated ability to manage budgets and make channel decisions based on profitability and customer quality.

Experience leading and developing marketing team members, setting KPIs, and managing performance.

Strong analytical judgment with the ability to challenge assumptions, validate agency recommendations, and translate data into clear actions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, with a proactive and concise reporting style.

Highly organized, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-moving environment.



Tools and Platforms

Google Workspace, ClickUp, Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon advertising and marketplace reports, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or Power BI, Klaviyo or a similar lifecycle platform, spreadsheets, and agency reporting systems.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter that addresses the following:

Describe a DTC or e-commerce business you helped grow and the results you personally influenced.

Share an example of how you used CAC, LTV, contribution margin, retention, or cohort data to make a marketing decision.

Describe your experience managing marketing agencies and holding them accountable to KPIs and deadlines.

List the advertising, analytics, e-commerce, and lifecycle marketing platforms you have used.



Applications that include specific examples and measurable outcomes will receive priority consideration.

title: Outbound Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - US Moving Company
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



MoveZilla Moving is a U.S.-based moving company looking for confident and experienced Outbound Cold Callers / Appointment Setters to join our growing sales team.



Your primary goal is simple: connect with potential customers who are planning a move, qualify their needs, and schedule an in-home estimate with one of our professional estimators.



We provide fresh lead lists every day, along with our power dialer, CRM, calling framework, training, and everything else you need to do the job. You do not need to find, source, or purchase your own leads.



This is a 100% commission-based position with uncapped earning potential.



COMPENSATION



• Starting commission: $35 USD per qualified in-home estimate booked

• No cap on commissions

• Additional monthly performance bonuses for reaching appointment milestones

• Commission rates increase over time based on performance, consistency, and tenure

• Strong performers will have opportunities to progress to higher per-appointment commission rates



MONTHLY PERFORMANCE BONUSES



Earn an additional monthly bonus based on the number of qualified appointments you book:



• 20 qualified appointments - $100 bonus

• 25 qualified appointments - $150 bonus

• 30 qualified appointments - $200 bonus

• 35 qualified appointments - $250 bonus

• 40 qualified appointments - $300 bonus



Your bonus increases by $50 for every additional 5 qualified appointments booked after reaching 20. The highest milestone reached determines your total monthly bonus.



Performance bonuses are paid in addition to your regular appointment commissions.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



• Fresh prospect lists every day - no lead sourcing required

• Power dialer

• CRM and lead management system

• Calling script/framework and objection-handling guidance

• Training and ongoing feedback

• An experienced estimating team that handles the in-home appointments and provides customers with their moving estimates



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Make outbound calls to U.S. prospects using our power dialer

• Introduce MoveZilla’s moving services naturally and professionally

• Identify customers who are planning an upcoming move

• Qualify prospects and schedule in-home estimates

• Follow up with interested prospects who aren’t ready to book immediately

• Handle common objections confidently and professionally

• Maintain accurate call notes, dispositions, and follow-up tasks in our CRM

• Consistently manage your assigned lead pipeline



You are not responsible for closing the moving job or preparing the moving estimate. Once you schedule a qualified in-home estimate, our estimating team takes over.



SCHEDULE



• Approximately 6 hours per day / 30 hours per week

• Monday–Friday required

• Work is performed during U.S. business hours

• This is a night-shift position in Philippine time

• Saturday is completely optional. Agents who want to make additional calls and increase their earning potential are welcome to work Saturdays as well.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Previous outbound cold calling / appointment-setting experience

• Experience calling U.S. customers is strongly preferred

• Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation

• Confident, friendly, and natural phone presence

• Strong listening and objection-handling skills

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

• Persistent and organized with follow-ups

• Able to follow a proven calling framework without sounding robotic

• Coachable and open to call reviews and feedback

• Reliable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet working environment

• Comfortable working during U.S. business hours



Previous experience in moving, home services, real estate, solar, roofing, insurance, or similar U.S. outbound campaigns is a strong plus.



TO APPLY



Start your application with the word MOVEZILLA so we know you’ve read the entire job post.



Please include:



1. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and briefly describing your cold-calling / appointment-setting experience. You can use Vocaroo, Google Drive, or another recording service and include a shareable link in your application.

2. How long you have been making outbound calls to U.S. customers.

3. The industries or campaigns you have previously worked on.

4. Your previous performance/results, if available - calls per day and appointments booked per week or month.

5. Your availability during U.S. business hours.



We’re looking for people who want to grow with us long term. Strong performers will have opportunities to earn more and take on greater responsibility as our sales team grows.

description:

• ________________________________________

How to Apply

Application Link: 
 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS).  This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.   



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via
 or by job postings.  Our HRIS system will require you to:

• Create a profile with a username and password for you to access throughout the recruiting process and if hired, it will be used for timekeeping and payroll. 

• Re-enter details already included in your resume (this helps us standardize globally).  We recognize this may seem repetitive but it ensures your profile is properly integrated into our global system which is necessary to schedule interviews and onboard. 

• Upload supporting documents such as your CV. 



Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates.  The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).  



Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment.  This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations.    This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team.  Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations.  DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development.  If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you. 



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel. 



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.

We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps.  If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help. 



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.

Our AI technology handles much of our initial lead follow-up and appointment setting. Your job is to take ownership of what happens next.



Responsibilities will include:



Managing and monitoring our Follow Up Boss database on a daily basis

Reviewing lead history, notes, communication, stages, tasks, and activity to understand what is happening with each lead

Managing Smart Lists and using them to identify leads and agents requiring attention

Monitoring the FUB Inbox, tasks, and lead activity

Understanding and working with Automations 2.0

Assigning leads and appointments to the appropriate agents

Making sure agents connect with leads at scheduled appointment times

Following up with agents to determine the outcome of appointments and ensuring those outcomes are properly documented

Monitoring required agent follow-up when an appointment is missed

Reassigning leads or returning them to our AI system when required follow-up is not completed

Identifying leads that are being neglected or are not being managed appropriately

Maintaining accurate stages, notes, tasks, and other CRM information

Troubleshooting FUB issues and helping us maintain clean, effective CRM processes

Identifying problems and recommending solutions rather than simply reporting that something isn't working

Assisting with other lead-management and administrative projects as needed

Follow Up Boss Expertise Is Essential



Please do not apply unless you have significant hands-on experience with Follow Up Boss.



Our ideal candidate should be comfortable working independently in an established FUB account and should have strong experience with:



Smart Lists

Inbox management

Tasks and task management

Automations 2.0

Lead stages and statuses

Lead assignment and reassignment

Notes and communication history

Agent follow-up and accountability

Database organization and cleanup

Identifying leads that need attention

Understanding how different parts of Follow Up Boss work together



Experience with Ylopo and Fello is a strong plus.



Who We're Looking For



This role requires more than someone who can follow a checklist. We are looking for someone who is sharp, highly organized, proactive, and an excellent critical thinker.



You should be comfortable reviewing the information available to you, figuring out what is happening, determining the appropriate next step, and taking action without needing constant direction.



You may be a great fit if you:



Have extensive Follow Up Boss experience

Have experience working in the U.S. real estate industry

Understand how real estate leads move through a CRM

Have strong attention to detail

Notice when something doesn't look right

Take ownership of your responsibilities

Follow through until an issue is resolved

Are comfortable holding agents accountable for required follow-up

Communicate clearly and professionally in written English

Can work independently without excessive supervision



This is not a phone ISA position. You will not be responsible for cold calling or converting leads by phone.



Schedule



Working hours will fall primarily during U.S. business hours.



How to Apply



Please send your résumé along with a short explanation of your specific Follow Up Boss experience to 



In your application, please tell us:



How long you have worked in Follow Up Boss.

What you have personally done inside FUB.

Your experience with Smart Lists.

Your experience with Automations 2.0.

Your experience managing agent follow-up and lead accountability.

Whether you have experience with Ylopo and/or Fello.

Your experience working with U.S. real estate teams or brokerages.

Your availability and desired hourly rate.



Please put “FUB EXPERT” in the subject line.



Applicants who do not provide details about their Follow Up Boss experience will not be considered.

title: Part-Time SEO & AI Search Content Assistant
description:
Small direct primary care clinic in Austin, TX looking for a part-time assistant to help people find us when they ask AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Google for a doctor.



More people now ask an AI "is direct primary care worth it?" instead of searching Google. We want our clinic to be the clear, trustworthy answer. You'll help us get there through accurate listings, useful website content, and genuinely helpful answers in online communities.



This role does not involve patient records or patient contact. Everything you draft is reviewed by our physician before it goes live.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Clean up and correct our listings on business directories (your first week).

2. Research the questions people ask AI search tools and draft website content that answers them, using recommendations from our AI search tracking tool.

3. Draft helpful replies to questions about primary care costs and access on Reddit, posted from our clinic's official account after review.

4. Publish approved posts in WordPress as our setup is finalized.

5. Keep a weekly timesheet with a short log of what you worked on.



REQUIRED

- Strong written English. Clear and natural, not robotic.

- 1+ year of SEO or content writing experience.

- Hands-on experience using Claude for writing or research. Claude Projects experience is a plus.

- Experience working in the WordPress editor.

- Solid web research skills and comfort with Google Docs and Sheets.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience participating in Reddit communities.

- Health or wellness writing.

- Familiarity with AEO or GEO (writing content that AI tools cite).



PAY AND SCHEDULE

- $5 to $7 per hour based on experience, paid bi-weekly in USD.

- 10 to 20 hours per week, flexible schedule, mostly asynchronous.

- One paid 30-minute video call per week during your first month: Wednesdays 7:00pm US Central (Thursday 8:00am Philippine time, 9:00am after November 1).

- The first 30 days are a paid trial with a review. Long-term role if it's a good fit.

- Start date: early October.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words STRAIGHT ANSWER.

2. Share links to 2 or 3 things you've written (SEO articles, website pages, or similar).

3. Tell us which Claude plan you currently use and one thing you've used it for.

4. Write a 100 to 150 word reply to this Reddit question, as if posting from a clinic's official account: "Is direct primary care worth it if I already have a high-deductible health plan?" Then add two sentences on why you wrote it the way you did.

5. Optional: a video under 3 minutes introducing yourself. Applications with a video are reviewed first.



We expect you to use AI tools. We're hiring for your judgment and editing, so the two sentences in step 4 matter more than the reply itself.



Applications without the code words or the writing task won't be reviewed.

title: Client Delivery Manager (Project Manager)
description:
Client Delivery Manager | Full-Time - Remote



The role in one paragraph

Your job is to make sure every client request and every video, script and thumbnail project moves from submission to delivery without being missed, delayed or left without an owner. You are the operational owner for a portfolio of clients: visible in Slack, coordinating the internal team, keeping Airtable true, resolving blockers and raising risks before the client feels them. This is not a passive task-tracking role. You are the person who makes sure the work actually moves and every loop closes.



About Views To Clients



Views To Clients is a fast-growing YouTube growth and production company working with some of the world's leading founders and brands, including Gary Vee, Manychat and Instantly.ai. We are building the strongest YouTube delivery operation in the market and need high-ownership operators who can keep pace with that ambition.



What you own:

Own the day-to-day delivery health of a portfolio of clients.

Be present in client Slack channels, acknowledge operational requests and give clear progress updates.

Turn client messages, submissions and decisions into properly owned work with a clear deadline.

Coordinate scriptwriters, editors, QAs, thumbnail designers, strategists and other internal owners.

Make sure new work is assigned the same day and accepted by the person responsible.

Track projects through delivery, chase progress and intervene before an issue becomes a missed deadline

Keep Airtable and the operating system aligned with reality at all times.

Identify blockers and weak plans early, then resolve or escalate them with a proposed next action

Verify that the correct result reaches the client before marking anything resolved.

Maintain clear daily visibility across what is healthy, at risk, overdue and unresolved.



Where the role stops

The Strategist owns YouTube strategy and results direction. QA and functional leaders own the quality standard inside their disciplines. Client Success leadership owns higher-stakes relationship calls, renewals, saves, expansion and commercial decisions.



You do not need to personally execute every specialist task, but you cannot treat another person's ownership as a reason for a client outcome to drift. Your job is to route the issue correctly, secure a credible commitment and make sure it reaches resolution.



Who will be exceptional here

You have strong agency project-management, client-delivery or creative-operations experience.

You have controlled several recurring client workstreams and cross-functional teams at once.

You naturally notice missing owners, vague deadlines and silent risks before somebody points them out.

You are direct, calm and comfortable holding talented people accountable.

Your written English and client communication are excellent.

You can prioritise quickly when several clients need attention at once.

You use systems such as Airtable, Asana, ClickUp or Monday as operational truth, not decoration.

You ask questions early, make sensible decisions without waiting for permission and close loops without being chased.



What success looks like

Clients do not need to chase us for status.

Actionable requests are captured and assigned within the required SLA.

Risks are raised before deadlines are missed.

Every live item has a clear owner, next action and deadline.

The system matches the real state of delivery.

Internal owners know exactly what is expected and by when.

Problems reach the client as controlled solutions, not silent surprises.

title: Full-Time AI Automation Developer | n8n, AI Agents, Python/JavaScript, GitHub
description:
FULL-TIME AI AUTOMATION & FULL-STACK DEVELOPER

n8n | AI Agents | OpenClaw | Hermes | Claude Code | Codex | Grok | GitHub



We are hiring a dedicated developer to work directly with the founder and build, deploy, maintain, and improve AI agents, business automations, internal tools, dashboards, and web applications.



You must be capable of taking a business idea, clarifying the requirements, recommending a practical approach, building the solution, and keeping it working after launch.



POSITION DETAILS



• Employment: Full-time, long-term, remote.

• Compensation: $2,000–$3,500 USD per month, depending on demonstrated experience and technical ability.

• Schedule: 40 hours per week, Monday–Saturday.

• Working overlap: At least 3 agreed hours each day overlapping with US Eastern Time. Remaining hours are flexible.

• Start date: Following a successful paid technical trial and any agreed notice period.

• Tools: Company-approved development tools, API usage, and hosting are paid separately.



FULL-TIME, EXCLUSIVE COMMITMENT — REQUIRED



This position is for someone who wants to become part of our team, take ownership, and build with us over the long term.



This is not a temporary position, a side job, or a project-by-project engagement. We are hiring an individual who is ready to make us their only employer/client during the engagement.



You must be willing to:



• Commit 40 working hours per week to this role.

• End other employment, paid freelance client work, and ongoing agency commitments before your agreed start date.

• Personally perform the work without outsourcing or subcontracting.

• Maintain consistent availability during the agreed schedule.

• Stay involved after launch to troubleshoot, maintain, and improve what you build.



If you intend to maintain multiple jobs, split your working time between clients, or accept outside client projects during this engagement, do not apply.



Currently employed applicants may apply if prepared to transition fully into this role. State your notice period and earliest exclusive start date.



WHAT YOU WILL BUILD



Projects may include:



• n8n workflows connecting business applications and automating recurring tasks.

• AI agents that retrieve information, use tools, and complete defined business processes.

• OpenClaw and Hermes deployments with custom tools, skills, and integrations.

• Internal dashboards, reporting tools, and administrative applications.

• Web applications and portals connected to databases and backend services.

• Integrations between CRMs,
, messaging platforms, calendars, documents, and other business systems.

• Adaptations of suitable open-source GitHub projects.



You will work from an agreed priority list with clear milestones. You should be comfortable recommending when to use an existing tool, adapt an open-source project, or write custom software.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS



1. n8n AND WORKFLOW AUTOMATION



You must be able to build and troubleshoot workflows beyond basic templates.



Required capabilities:



• Webhook, scheduled, and event-triggered workflows.

• HTTP requests, REST APIs, JSON, and data transformation.

• API keys, OAuth, and credential management.

• Conditional logic, branching, loops, and reusable sub-workflows.

• Custom JavaScript or other supported code steps.

• Pagination, rate limits, timeouts, retries, and error handling.

• Duplicate prevention so repeated events do not create repeated actions.

• Execution logs, failure alerts, and workflow troubleshooting.

• Connecting workflows to databases, CRMs,
, messaging, and other applications.

• Maintaining and updating workflows without disrupting existing processes.



2. AI AGENT DEVELOPMENT



You must have built working agents that perform tasks through tools or integrations.



Required capabilities:



• Tool calling and structured outputs.

• Connecting agents to APIs and business applications.

• Retrieving relevant information from documents or databases.

• Managing conversation state, context, and persistent memory appropriately.

• Designing multistep workflows with clear completion criteria.

• Adding approval steps before sensitive or consequential actions.

• Handling failed tool calls, invalid outputs, and incomplete tasks.

• Setting execution limits to prevent runaway loops and unnecessary spending.

• Testing whether an agent completes its intended task reliably.

• Understanding when a predictable automation is more appropriate than an agent.



3. OPENCLAW AND HERMES



Hands-on experience with both is required. State your experience with each separately.



You should be able to:



• Install, configure, and run the system.

• Connect supported model providers and tools.

• Configure available integrations, skills, memory, and scheduled tasks.

• Customize or extend functionality for a defined use case.

• Diagnose configuration, authentication, dependency, and runtime problems.

• Manage updates and document the deployment.

• Explain what you personally built or configured.



4. CLAUDE CODE AND CODEX



You must be comfortable using both as part of a software development workflow.



You should be able to:



• Work inside an existing repository.

• Give coding tools clear requirements and project context.

• Review generated code and identify incorrect assumptions.

• Run tests, debug failures, and verify functionality.

• Inspect changes before committing or deploying them.

• Explain the code and architecture you deliver.

• Maintain and modify the system without depending on blindly generated output.



5. MODEL API INTEGRATIONS



Experience integrating Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI, and xAI/Grok is required.



You should understand:



• Authentication, model selection, and request configuration.

• Tool calling and structured responses.

• Context limits, token usage, rate limits, and timeouts.

• Error handling and appropriate fallback behavior.

• Tracking usage and estimating operating costs.

• Choosing a model based on task requirements, reliability, speed, and cost.



6. PROGRAMMING AND BACKEND DEVELOPMENT



Strong proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript is required.



You must be able to:



• Write, read, debug, and maintain custom code.

• Build backend services and API endpoints.

• Work with asynchronous tasks and external integrations.

• Validate inputs and handle errors clearly.

• Manage dependencies and environment configuration.

• Write meaningful tests for important functionality.

• Read unfamiliar codebases and make controlled changes.



7. DATABASES AND DATA HANDLING



You should have practical experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or an equivalent system.



Required capabilities:



• Designing appropriate tables and relationships.

• Reading, inserting, updating, and querying records.

• Managing schema changes and migrations.

• Maintaining data consistency and avoiding duplicate records.

• Applying appropriate access permissions.

• Backing up and restoring application data.

• Connecting databases to applications, workflows, and agents.



8. GIT AND GITHUB



You must be comfortable managing real development work through GitHub.



Required capabilities:



• Cloning, evaluating, and adapting existing repositories.

• Understanding project dependencies, maintenance status, and license restrictions before reuse.

• Working with branches, commits, pull requests, and code reviews.

• Resolving merge conflicts and reverting problematic changes.

• Tracking issues and documenting setup instructions.

• Keeping API keys, credentials, and private data out of repositories.

• Configuring or maintaining basic automated checks and deployment workflows, including GitHub Actions when appropriate.



9. FULL-STACK APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT



You must be able to connect a usable interface to a working backend.



Required capabilities:



• Building responsive dashboards, forms, and administrative interfaces.

• Using a modern frontend framework such as React/Next.js or an equivalent.

• Implementing authentication and appropriate user permissions.

• Connecting interfaces to APIs and databases.

• Handling loading, empty, success, and error states.

• Verifying that buttons, forms, navigation, and data updates work end to end.

• Troubleshooting problems across the frontend, backend, and database.



10. DEPLOYMENT AND SYSTEM MAINTENANCE



You must be able to deploy and support what you build.



Required capabilities:



• Working with cloud hosting or Linux servers.

• Using the command line and reading application logs.

• Configuring environment variables and credentials securely.

• Working with Docker or comparable deployment tooling.

• Setting up domains and HTTPS when needed.

• Monitoring availability, failures, and resource usage.

• Managing backups, updates, and recovery procedures.

• Maintaining a practical rollback plan for significant changes.

• Documenting enough detail for another developer to operate the system.



EXPERIENCE AND WORKING STYLE



We are looking for:



• Approximately 3+ years of software development experience, or equivalent evidence of substantial shipped projects.

• Demonstrated experience with AI agents and business automation.

• Ability to work independently on clearly defined objectives.

• Clear written and spoken English.

• Willingness to ask questions before making consequential assumptions.

• Honest estimates and early communication about blockers.

• Attention to reliability, usability, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

• Ability to recommend simpler solutions when they meet the business need.

• Reliable internet and a computer suitable for development work.



HOW WE WORK



• Tasks are prioritized with the founder.

• Deliverables include working software, verification, and documentation.

• Provide a brief daily update covering completed work, next steps, and blockers.

• Give a weekly demonstration of working progress.

• Keep code, workflows, project files, and deployment accounts under company ownership.

• Get approval before introducing new paid services or materially increasing operating costs.

• Use sample or test data during development where appropriate.

• Maintain the systems you deliver and address issues during agreed working hours.



INITIAL SUCCESS EXPECTATIONS



During the first month, you should be able to:



• Understand our initial priorities and recommend a practical implementation plan.

• Establish organized repositories, development environments, and deployment documentation.

• Deliver an agreed first automation or agent with working integrations.

• Demonstrate handling of failures and repeated inputs.

• Explain the solution, its limitations, and its operating costs.

• Leave clear instructions for setup, maintenance, and recovery.



Specific deliverables will be agreed based on project scope.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this application subject:



AI Developer — [Your Name] — Full-Time Exclusive



Include ALL of the following:



1. Your résumé, location, and time zone.



2. Your desired monthly compensation in USD.



3. Your available start date, required notice period, and proposed working hours in US Eastern Time.



4. Two relevant working projects you personally built. Explain the problem, your contribution, the tools used, and whether the system is currently in use.



5. A 3–5 minute video demonstrating an n8n workflow or AI agent you built. Show how it works and explain one technical challenge you solved.



6. Your GitHub profile or a walkthrough of private code you have permission to share. Identify your own contributions.



7. Your experience with each of the following separately:

   n8n, OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Anthropic API, OpenAI API, xAI/Grok API, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, databases, GitHub, and deployment.



For each, distinguish professional use, personal projects, and no experience. Do not claim experience you cannot demonstrate.



8. One example of a system failure you diagnosed and fixed.



9. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a small paid technical trial.



10. Include this statement:



“I understand this is a long-term, full-time, exclusive role. If hired, I will make this my only employer/client, end other paid work commitments before my agreed start date, commit 40 hours per week, and personally perform the work.”



SELECTION PROCESS



• Application and project-evidence review.

• Technical interview and walkthrough of your own work.

• A small live modification or troubleshooting exercise.

• A scoped paid technical trial for finalists, with payment and expectations agreed beforehand.



AI coding tools are allowed during the evaluation. You must understand, explain, test, and take responsibility for the work.



Applications without the requested project evidence and exclusivity confirmation will not be considered. Tutorial-only examples and lists of tool names are insufficient.



Share only work and code you have permission to disclose.

 Submit all items below. Applications missing any of the following, including the bilingual video requirement below, will not be reviewed.

title: Recruiter
description:
Position Summary

The Recruitment Coordinator calls every applicant YESA receives online, qualifies them on the phone, and books the ones who pass into a recruiter's calendar. The measure of the role is booked interviews that show up — not dials logged.

This is a high-volume phone role. Applicant flow for door-to-door field sales is heavy and low-intent: most people who apply will not answer, and most who answer will not qualify. The Coordinator works that volume fast and without losing tone on the fortieth call of the day, so that recruiters spend their time interviewing qualified people instead of chasing unqualified ones.

Speed is the job's main lever. An applicant contacted within five minutes converts several times better than one contacted the next day, and YESA competes for the same candidates as every other field sales employer in the market. The Coordinator owns that response window.



This is a fully remote role, hired internationally, working North American business hours for the assigned market. The Coordinator reports to the Recruiter or Recruitment Manager for that market, and is the first human contact a candidate has with YESA — how that call sounds is how the company is judged.



What Success Looks Like

By 30 days — Trained on the YESA screen criteria, ATS and calendar process. Working the inbound queue independently. Hitting call volume, booking at roughly 70% of target.

By 60 days — Full booking target met weekly. Show rate above 60%. Working aged applicants and re-engagement lists, not just today's inbound.

By 90 days — Program complete, rate steps up. Consistently at target on booked-and-showed. Booked candidates converting to starts at a rate recruiters trust.

Key Performance Indicators

The Coordinator is measured on booked interviews that show, not on activity. Dial and contact volume are inputs the manager watches for coaching; they are not the target.

• Dials — 120–150 per day, 600–750 per week. Outbound call attempts to applicants.

• Live connects — 25–35 per day, 125–175 per week. Applicant answered and held a conversation.

• Qualified — 15–20 per day, 75–100 per week. Passed the screen criteria on the phone.

• Interviews booked — 12–15 per day, 60–75 per week. Confirmed slot in a recruiter's calendar.

• Booked and showed — 8–10 per day, 40–50 per week. Candidate attended. This is the primary target.

• Show rate — 65% or higher. Showed divided by booked.

• Speed to lead — 15 minutes or less, median, from application to first dial.

—

Weekly targets are set to feed one recruiter running at full capacity: 40–50 completed interviews per week is the recruiter's own target, and it only holds if the Coordinator is booking 60–75 to get there.

Two quality checks sit behind the volume. Downstream start rate — what share of showed candidates the recruiter takes to a signed offer — catches a Coordinator who is booking anyone to hit a number. Qualification accuracy — candidates who reach interview and fail on travel or direct sales experience, both of which should have been caught on the phone — is reviewed weekly with the recruiter and should sit under 10%.



Core Responsibilities

Applicant response

• Work the inbound applicant queue continuously through the day; call every new applicant within 15 minutes during business hours

• Run a persistent contact sequence — multiple call attempts across different times of day, plus text and
 — before marking an applicant unreachable

• Work aged and previously unreachable applicants on a set cadence; a candidate who did not answer in March may answer in May

Phone qualification

• Run the YESA phone screen on every live connect: right to work, travel and schedule availability, transportation, compensation expectations, and genuine interest in field sales

• Give an honest description of the work — doors, weather, rejection, commission — before booking. A candidate who books without understanding the job becomes a no-show or a week-three quit

• Disqualify clearly and respectfully when someone does not fit, and record why

Booking and show rate

• Book qualified candidates directly into the assigned recruiter's calendar, matching market and interview type

• Confirm every booking the same day and again the day before, by the channel the candidate actually responds on

• Rebook no-shows once; track no-show reasons and feed the patterns back to the recruiter

Pipeline and handoff

• Keep the ATS current in real time — dispositions, notes, and screen answers recorded during the call, not at the end of the day

• Write a short handoff note for every booked candidate so the recruiter opens the interview already knowing the basics

• Flag standout candidates immediately rather than letting them sit in a queue

Support

• Support hiring events and job fairs with pre-event confirmation calling and post-event follow-up

• Post and refresh job ads across boards as directed



Requirements

Must have

• Phone-based sales, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound experience. They have carried a daily call and booking target and can say what their numbers were. Recruitment experience is not required; phone stamina is

• Clear, easily understood spoken English. A North American applicant should be able to follow the call without effort. This is the single most common reason offshore coordinators fail in this role

• Experience calling into North American markets, or clear evidence they can handle the pace and idiom of those conversations

• Comfort making 120+ dials a day, indefinitely, with the same energy on the last call as the first

• Ability to hold a structured conversation and disqualify without being rude — warm on the phone, firm on the criteria

• Organized in a system: manages a live queue, records accurately as they go, does not lose people

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a working headset, and a contingency for power or internet outages. Verified before hire, not assumed

• Available to work North American business hours for the assigned market, including some evenings and occasional Saturdays — that is when field sales applicants answer

• Able to be engaged as an independent contractor in their country of residence

Strongly preferred

• Experience calling into a cold or low-intent applicant or lead list, rather than warm inbound only

• Background in door-to-door, telecom, solar, alarm, or another commission-only field sales environment — they can describe the job credibly because they have lived it

• ATS or CRM fluency and comfort managing 200+ active records

• Bilingual English/French for Quebec markets

• Experience in a role where pay was tied to booked-and-showed, not dials



Screen-outs

Confirmed before the candidate reaches a live interview. Cannot sustain the call volume, or wants a role where calling is a portion of the day rather than the whole of it — decline. Cannot describe the field sales job honestly without apologizing for it — decline; the same squeamishness will cost YESA shows and starts.



Compensation

USD $9.00/hour, rising to USD $10.00/hour on completion of the 90-day program. Engaged as an independent contractor, responsible for their own taxes and statutory obligations in their country of residence.

title: Short Form Video & Photo Creative Editor
description:
We're not looking for just another video editor looking for a job.



We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented video editor who understands that great short-form content is about much more than cutting clips together.



You'll be working directly with Tyler & Jessica from JVT Media to edit short-form content primarily for Jessica's social media. You'll also spend a smaller portion of your time helping create photo & video creatives for our advertising campaigns.



If you understand storytelling, pacing, hooks, trends, music, and what makes someone stop scrolling, this could be a great fit for you.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, moves quickly, pays attention to the small details, and is constantly looking for ways to make their edits better.



We don't want someone who simply follows instructions and checks a box.



We want someone who can take a large amount of raw footage, understand the story we're trying to tell, find the best moments, and turn them into short-form content that people actually want to watch.



This is intended to be a long-term position starting at 15 hours a week. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, develop their editing skills, grow into a full time 40 hour a week position and become an important part of our creative team.



As you read this description, feel free to ask any questions you have. Clear communication and curiosity are valued here.



This posting is for an audition. We will choose several candidates for a paid test project. After reviewing everyone's work, we'll d
 who we'd like to bring onto the team long term.



POSITION OVERVIEW



Your primary responsibility will be editing short-form video content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, Meta Ads.



Jessica will provide raw footage and creative direction, and your job will be to turn that footage into engaging, polished, platform-ready content.



You'll need to be comfortable working with large amounts of raw footage and identifying the strongest 1–3 second moments that fit the story being told.



You'll also spend a smaller portion of your time helping create video-based ad creatives for our advertising campaigns.



The ideal person understands that editing isn't just about making a video look good.



It's about understanding:



• What makes someone stop scrolling.



• How to create a strong hook in the first few seconds.



• How to maintain attention throughout a video.



• How to use pacing and pattern interrupts effectively.



• How to tell a story with limited time.



• How music, visuals, text, and voiceovers work together.



• What makes content feel native to Instagram and TikTok.



• How trends and current culture can be used to make content more relevant.



• How to look at performance and use that information to make the next video better.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Short-Form Video Editing



Edit Instagram Reels, TikToks, and Meta Ad creatives using raw footage provided by Jessica and the team.



• Storytelling & Clip Selection



Review large quantities of raw footage and identify the strongest moments that support the story, message, and overall goal of each video.



You should be able to recognize when a clip is worth using, and when it isn't.



• Hooks & Retention



Create strong visual and narrative hooks at the beginning of videos that immediately capture attention.



You'll be expected to think critically about whether the first few seconds of a video are strong enough to make someone stop scrolling.



• Pacing



Create engaging pacing that matches the content, music, voiceovers, and story.



You'll need to understand when a video needs to move quickly and when slowing down creates a stronger emotional impact.



• On-Screen Text



Create engaging, visually appealing on-screen text that is consistent across videos while still feeling creative, current, and native to short-form platforms.



• Captions & Subtitles



Add and clean up captions/subtitles, including correcting spelling, punctuation, timing, formatting, and styling.



• Audio



Handle basic audio mixing, including voiceover levelling, music levels, noise reduction, and ensuring dialogue is clear and easy to understand.



• Colour Correction & Grading



Apply basic colour correction and grading to ensure footage looks clean, consistent, and professional.



• Music & Trends



Stay aware of current Instagram and TikTok trends, including popular sounds and editing styles, and understand when they may be appropriate to incorporate into content.



• Ad Creative



Spend a smaller portion of your time creating and editing photo & video creatives for Meta advertising campaigns.



This may include adapting organic content into ads, creating different hooks or variations, and editing footage and images specifically for advertising purposes.



• File Organization



Keep footage, project files, exports, and other assets organized using our naming conventions and folder structures.



• Continuous Improvement



Constantly look for ways to improve your editing process, work more efficiently, and raise the quality of the content you produce.



This includes learning new editing features, functions, techniques, and AI tools that can improve your workflow.



WHAT A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT LOOK LIKE



No two weeks will be exactly the same, but your week might include things like:



• Reviewing a large batch of raw footage.



• Selecting the strongest clips and moments for upcoming Reels.



• Editing short-form videos from start to finish.



• Creating strong hooks and opening sequences.



• Adding captions and engaging on-screen text.



• Matching edits to music and voiceovers.



• Cleaning up audio and balancing music levels.



• Applying basic colour and brightness adjustments



• Researching current TikTok and Instagram trends.



• Making revisions based on feedback.



• Creating variations of photo & video creatives for Meta advertising.



• Organizing project files and completed videos.



• Updating project trackers.



• Reviewing performance and thinking about how future videos can be improved.



• Learning new editing techniques, features, and AI tools to improve your work.



QUALITIES NEEDED TO BE SUCCESSFUL



At JVT Media, we're looking for more than someone who knows how to use an editing program.



The technical skills can continue to improve.



What matters most is how you think, how you work, and how much pride you take in what you create.



• Creativity



You have a strong creative eye and genuinely enjoy making content. You understand aesthetic composition, visual storytelling, pacing, and what makes a video feel engaging.



• Storytelling



You understand that every good short-form video has a reason for existing. You can identify the story and use footage, pacing, music, text, and editing to communicate it effectively.



• Attention to Detail



You notice the small things, awkward cuts, spelling mistakes, inconsistent text, poor audio levels, unnecessary pauses, bad framing, and anything else that makes an edit feel less polished.



• Performance Mindset



You're interested in what actually performs, not just what looks good.



You pay attention to engagement, retention, audience response, and trends, and use that information to make each video better than the last.



• Speed & Efficiency



You work quickly without sacrificing quality. You're constantly looking for ways to improve your workflow and get better results in less time.



• Coachability



You take feedback well. You don't get defensive when something needs to change, you use feedback to improve your editing and your understanding of what we want.



• Reliability



When you say something will be done, it's done. You communicate early if something is unclear or if a deadline is at risk.



• Initiative



You don't need to be told every single thing to do.



If you see an opportunity to improve an edit, try a different approach, test a new trend, or make something better, we want you to speak up.



• Organization



You can manage multiple projects and deadlines without letting things fall through the cracks.



• Positive Attitude



We want someone who genuinely enjoys the work they do and is a positive, enjoyable person to work with every day.



REQUIREMENTS



• Previous experience editing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts.



• Strong understanding of short-form storytelling and social media content.



• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and audience engagement.



• Ability to work with large quantities of raw footage and identify the strongest clips.



• Experience with captions, subtitles, and on-screen text.



• Basic understanding of colour correction and grading.



• Basic understanding of audio mixing, noise reduction, and voiceover/music balancing.



• Strong attention to detail.



• Ability to follow creative direction accurately.



• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and stay organized.



• Strong written and verbal communication.



• Experience with CapCut.



• Experience with Canva.



• Fast and reliable internet connection.



• Willingness to learn and adapt quickly.



• Ability to work during EST business hours when needed.



BONUS (NOT REQUIRED)



• Experience editing for personal brands or creators.



• Experience creating Meta/Facebook/Instagram ad creatives.



• Experience working with marketing agencies.



WHAT WE OFFER



• Part-time hours to start.



• Opportunity for the role to grow to full time as our content needs increase.



• Long-term opportunity with a growing digital marketing agency.



• Performance bonuses and raises.



• Clear creative direction and communication.



• A positive and supportive remote work environment.



• Opportunity to develop your short-form editing and digital marketing skills.



• Opportunity to work on both organic social content and advertising creatives.



• Room to take on more responsibility as you prove yourself.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send the following:



• A short introduction about yourself.



• Your experience editing Reels, TikToks, Shorts, or other short-form content.



• Links to 3–5 examples of your best short-form video edits.



• Links to 3-5 examples of your best photo creatives 



Please choose examples that best demonstrate your storytelling, pacing, hooks, text, captions, and overall creative ability.



• The editing software you currently use and your experience with CapCut and Canva.



• Your typical weekly availability and how many hours you can commit to this role.



• Your current employment situation and whether you're currently working with other clients or companies.



• A short message explaining what interests you about this position.



BONUS: If you'd like to stand out, include a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself, showing us some of your work, and explaining why you think you'd be a great fit for the role.



We care much more about the quality of your work and how you think than simply how many years you've been editing.



If you have any questions, please ask. You can never ask too many!



To confirm you've read the entire job posting, please begin your application with the phrase:



"JVT Media"



We look forward to meeting you!



Tyler & Jessica

JVT Media

title: VA Success Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a thoughtful, proactive, and relationship-focused VA Success Manager tosupport Virtual Assistants before and after they are placed with clients.



This role is responsible for helping VAs succeed through onboarding, readiness training,healthcare training, coaching, engagement check-ins, performance follow-up, documentation, and escalation support.



This is not a recruiting or sourcing role. Talent acquisition is handled separately.



The ideal candidate has experience supporting or training VAs in healthcare, dental, medical, or healthcare-adjacent roles. This person should be comfortable coaching remote team members, identifying performance risks early, and helping VAs understand the communication, professionalism, documentation, and service standards expected in healthcare client environments. This role requires strong judgment, curiosity, emotional intelligence, and the ability to balance empathy with accountability.



What You’ll Do



VA Onboarding, Readiness & Healthcare Training

* Orient new VA batches and help prepare them for client placement

* Conduct pre-start onboarding so VAs understand expectations before beginning with a client

* Run readiness and development training for VAs

* Provide or support healthcare training related to communication standards, professionalism, patient/client sensitivity, documentation, privacy awareness, and service expectations

* Validate VA engagement before placement

* Reinforce role clarity, attendance expectations, responsiveness, and accountability

* Help maintain warm-pool engagement for VAs who are preparing for placement or waiting for assignment



Placed VA Support & Coaching

* Build strong working relationships with active VAs

* Conduct monthly alignment sessions and engagement check-ins

* Coach VAs through communication, professionalism, performance, attendance, or role clarity concerns

* Help VAs understand client expectations and how to succeed in their role

* Facilitate structured coaching cycles based on the level of support needed

* Identify when a VA needs additional support, retraining, clarification, escalation, or replacement or consideration

* Reinforce high standards for remote work, communication, professionalism, and follow-through



Performance Monitoring & Retention

* Monitor VA engagement, performance health, and retention risk

* Identify early warning signs such as disengagement, poor responsiveness, missed expectations, communication issues, or role mismatch

* Help create recovery or improvement plans when concerns arise

* Track whether coaching and action plans are improving performance

* Escalate concerns or recommend replacement when performance thresholds are not being met

* Support strong VA retention by improving readiness, role clarity, communication, and support



Client Success Team Partnership

* Partner with Client Success Managers to understand client feedback, expectations, and performance concerns

* Coordinate coaching priorities based on client feedback

* Help determine whether an issue is related to training, communication, performance, role fit, or expectation mismatch

* Support structured recovery and action plans when client or VA concerns arise

* Communicate risks, trends, and recommendations clearly to the internal team

* Work cross-functionally with Client Success, Recruitment, Operations, and Leadership to improve outcomes



Documentation & Follow-Through

Maintain accurate documentation of:

* Attendance

* Evaluations

* Recordings

* Coaching notes

* Engagement check-ins

* Escalation logs

* Exit notes

* Recommendations

* Track follow-up items until resolved

* Keep records organized and easy for leadership and the client success team to review

* Provide monthly summaries to leadership on VA status, risks, coaching needs, and recommendations

* Ensure no performance concern, follow-up, or escalation falls through the cracks



Program Improvement

* Identify recurring performance gaps across VAs

* Recommend improvements to orientation, onboarding, healthcare training, hiring filters, communication standards, and lifecycle processes

* Help improve playbooks, templates, trackers, training materials, and coaching workflows

* Use dashboards, documentation, AI tools, or automation to improve visibility, productivity, and retention over time



Required Experience

* Experience supporting, coaching, training, or managing Virtual Assistants or remote team members

* Healthcare, dental, medical, orthodontic, or healthcare-adjacent training experience required

* Experience helping team members understand healthcare client expectations, communication standards, professionalism, and documentation requirements

* Experience in VA management, team leadership, HR support, operations, client success, coaching, training, or a similar people-support role

* Strong relationship management skills

* Strong written and spoken English communication

* Excellent judgment and emotional intelligence

* Ability to stay calm and professional during difficult conversations

* Ability to ask thoughtful questions and understand the full situation before making

recommendations

* Strong documentation and follow-up habits

* Comfortable working with remote teams

* Able to balance empathy with accountability

* Reliable, responsive, organized, and highly professional



What This Role Is Not

* This is not a recruiting role.

* This is not a sourcing role.

* This is not a basic administrative role.

* This role is about preparing, supporting, coaching, and retaining VAs, especially those serving healthcare-related clients. The right person must be able to identify performance risks, support improvement, partner with Client Success, and help build stronger systems for onboarding, training, and retention.



What Success Looks Like

* VAs are better prepared before placement

* Healthcare-related training expectations are clear and reinforced

* VAs understand client expectations, professionalism standards, and communication requirements

* Placed VAs feel supported, guided, and connected

* Performance concerns are identified early

* Coaching and recovery plans are followed through

* Client feedback is translated into clear VA coaching actions

* Documentation is accurate and useful

* Leadership has visibility into VA health, risks, retention concerns, and recommendations

* Strong VAs are retained and supported

* Poor-fit situations are identified thoughtfully and escalated appropriately

* Onboarding, healthcare training, and coaching systems improve over time

 $5-7 per hour. If someone's an absolute rockstar we’re willing to compensate.

title: Senior YouTube Video Editor | Long-Form Business Content
description:
We're hiring another talented YouTube video editor to join our growing content team long-term.



We're specifically looking for editors who already have strong experience producing polished long-form YouTube content — especially talking-head, business, personal brand, real estate, podcast, or educational content.



This is intended to become a full-time position.



The first month will begin as a PAID part-time training/trial period. During that time, you'll work directly with our existing editing team, learn our style and workflow, edit real projects, receive feedback, and show us how well you can adapt and improve.



If it's a strong fit on both sides, the goal is to transition you into a full-time role.



FULL-TIME COMPENSATION



$1,000-$2,000 USD/month depending on your ability, experience, communication, and performance.



There is room to grow beyond this over time as you become more valuable to the team and take on additional responsibility.



ABOUT US



We're a U.S.-based content and social media agency working primarily with real estate professionals, business owners, and personal brands.



I've personally been creating content for more than 7 years and have built an audience of more than 1 million followers across social media.



We now have a growing agency, multiple clients, an established editing team, and consistent work.



This isn't a short-term freelance project where we'll need a few videos and disappear.



We're looking for editors who want consistent work, want to become excellent at what they do, and would like to grow with the team long-term.



THE ROLE



Most of your work will be long-form YouTube content, primarily:



• Talking-head business videos

• Educational YouTube videos

• Real estate content

• Personal brand content

• Podcast-style content

• Approximately 8-20+ minute videos

• Occasional Shorts, Reels, and TikToks



We're looking for someone who can take raw footage and turn it into a polished, professional, engaging piece of content.



The editing should feel premium enough for established business owners while still being engaging enough to hold attention on YouTube and social media.



We want editors who understand storytelling and viewer retention — not someone who simply cuts out mistakes and exports the video.



Your edits may include:



• Strong pacing and storytelling

• Relevant B-roll

• Music and sound design

• Clean text and graphics

• Motion graphics when appropriate

• Visual changes and reframing

• Screenshots, images, articles, maps, or supporting visuals

• Creative use of AI-generated visuals where appropriate

• Other creative elements that help explain or strengthen the story



We don't want unnecessary effects just for the sake of making something flashy.



Every visual choice should help make the video clearer, more engaging, or more interesting to watch.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should:



• Have strong experience editing long-form YouTube content

• Understand talking-head and business content

• Have good creative judgment

• Understand pacing, storytelling, and retention

• Be able to create clean and professional graphics

• Know how to select relevant B-roll and supporting visuals

• Have strong attention to detail

• Communicate clearly and professionally

• Work well with a team

• Be reliable and consistent

• Take feedback well

• Be coachable and willing to improve

• Be comfortable making revisions

• Be able to follow an established editing style

• Also bring your own creative ideas when appropriate

• Be interested in a long-term position



You do NOT need to already edit exactly like our current team.



We care about strong fundamentals, creativity, professionalism, and your ability to learn our system.



HOW TO APPLY



Please follow these instructions carefully.



Generic or AI-generated applications will be disregarded.



Start your application with:



EFFLUINCE EDITOR



Then send:



1. Your 3 BEST long-form videos that you personally edited.



Do not send your entire portfolio. We want to see the three examples that best represent your current ability.



2. Briefly tell us exactly what you were responsible for in each video.



3. Send your best short-form edit if you have one.



4. What editing software do you primarily use?



5. Are you currently working with any other clients or companies?



6. How many hours per week are you currently available?



7. What monthly salary would you expect if you transitioned into a full-time role?



8. Choose ONE of the long-form videos you submitted and briefly explain one editing decision you made that you believe improved the video.



9. Send a short 60-second video introducing yourself.



In the video, tell us:



• Your name

• How long you've been editing

• What type of videos you enjoy editing most

• One thing you believe separates a great YouTube editor from an average one



A simple phone or webcam recording is completely fine.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a short paid editing test using real footage from our team.



The strongest candidates will then move into our paid part-time training/trial period with the opportunity to become a long-term full-time member of our editing team.



If you're talented, professional, easy to work with, open to feedback, and want consistent work with a growing content company, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Lead Research Specialist
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented Lead Research Specialist responsible for identifying and verifying key decision-makers within target organizations.



The primary focus of this role is to research organizations, identify the most relevant executives or leadership contacts, and accurately gather their professional contact information using tools such as Google, LinkedIn, and Clay. The Lead Research Specialist will ensure that all information entered into company research spreadsheets is accurate, relevant, and properly verified before moving to the next prospect.



The research process includes confirming the legitimacy of organizations, locating official websites and LinkedIn company pages, identifying appropriate leadership contacts, and validating contact information.







Key Responsibilities

-Research assigned organizations using Google, company websites, LinkedIn, and other reliable public sources.

-Confirm that each target organization is legitimate and identify its official website and relevant company information.

-Locate and review the organization's official LinkedIn company page.

-Identify the most appropriate decision-maker or leadership contact based on roles such as:

CEO

President

Vice President

Director

Executive

Chief-level executive

Managing Partner

Partner

Other relevant senior leadership positions.

-Verify that the selected lead has an active LinkedIn profile before using Clay, helping reduce unnecessary credit usage and improve lead accuracy.

-Record the lead's name, position/title, and LinkedIn profile in the assigned research sheet.

-Use Clay to identify and validate the target contact's professional
 address.

-Confirm whether Clay identifies an active or verified work
 before recording it.

-Research the contact's direct phone number or the organization's main office phone number through the official website, ----LinkedIn, or other reliable public sources.

-Cross-check all information before entering it into the database or spreadsheet.

-Use ChatGPT as a secondary research source when necessary, but verify any information against LinkedIn or the -organization's official website before recording it.

-Complete all available required information for each organization before proceeding to the next assigned company.





Required Skills

Strong online research skills are essential for this position. The ideal candidate should be comfortable navigating LinkedIn, Google, company websites, spreadsheets, and lead enrichment platforms such as Clay.

Candidates should also demonstrate strong attention to detail, the ability to distinguish reliable information from inaccurate or outdated sources, good judgment when identifying company decision-makers, organized data-entry habits, and the ability to follow a repeatable research process consistently.





Tools Used

LinkedIn — company and leadership research

 Google — organization verification and additional research

 Clay —
 discovery and validation

 Google Sheets or assigned research files — recording lead information

 ChatGPT — secondary research and information support when required

The SOP specifically establishes Clay and LinkedIn as core research tools.





Key Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured primarily by the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of researched lead information, rather than simply the number of contacts collected.



Researchers are expected to select the most relevant decision-maker, verify LinkedIn presence before consuming Clay credits, provide validated contact information whenever available, properly cross-check research, and maintain accurate and organized records.



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is highly resourceful, patient, organized, and comfortable performing detailed online research. They should be able to investigate companies independently, identify the correct senior-level contact even when information is not immediately available, and carefully verify information before submitting it.

This role is especially suited for someone who enjoys lead generation, prospect research, LinkedIn research, data enrichment, and database management and who understands that clean, accurate data is critical to successful outreach campaigns.

title: Media Buyer

* Manage and optimize Meta Ads accounts for lead generation campaigns

* Take full ownership of campaign performance, budgets, and results

* Build and launch campaigns, ad sets, and ads from start to finish

* Monitor CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, and overall campaign performance

* Test different audiences, creatives, hooks, offers, headlines, primary text, and bidding strategies

* Write compelling, conversion-focused **Meta ad copy** that aligns with the target audience and offer

* Understand how to create strong hooks and messaging that can generate quality leads

* Review ad performance and identify what should be scaled, paused, or improved

* Work closely with the creative team to provide direction on winning ad angles, concepts, and creative variations

* Track daily and monthly ad spend, performance, and projections in Google Sheets

* Monitor lead quality and work with the team to identify whether campaigns are generating actual business opportunities, not just cheap leads

* Troubleshoot campaign issues and proactively identify opportunities for improvement

* Provide clear performance updates, insights, and actionable optimization recommendations

* Stay up to date with Meta Ads best practices, platform changes, and lead generation strategies

* Help develop testing strategies to continuously improve campaign performance



Requirements



* 1+ year of hands-on Meta Ads experience, specifically with lead generation

* Experience managing $50k+/month in ad spend

* Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign structure

* Proven ability to analyze campaign data and make informed optimization decisions

* Strong ad copywriting skills — you should be comfortable writing hooks, primary text, headlines, and CTAs

* Good understanding of marketing psychology, offers, audiences, and conversion-focused messaging

* Proficient with Ads Manager, GoHighLevel, Canva, and Google Sheets

* Able to communicate clearly and explain the reasoning behind campaign decisions

* Data-driven, proactive, and highly organized

* Strong attention to detail and ability to catch issues before they become problems

* Self-starter who can work independently without needing constant direction

* Comfortable taking ownership and being accountable for campaign performance



Who We’re Looking For



We want someone who doesn’t just *run ads.” You should understand the entire lead generation process and be able to look at a campaign and answer:



What is working? What isn’t working? Why? And what should we do next?



You should be able to combine data + strategy + creative thinking to continuously improve results.



Details



1. Full-Time: 40 hrs/week (8am-5pm PST Monday-Friday)
