title: Technical Support Specialist (LED Lighting Controls, DMX/Pixel) with AutoCAD
description:
We're Green LED Lighting Solutions, a Canadian LED manufacturer. Our systems go into buildings, signs and entertainment venues across North America, and when an installer is on a job site with a controller that won't talk to the pixels, they call us. We need one more person on that phone.



SHIFT: North American business hours, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern (9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila). Fixed schedule, Monday to Friday.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Take technical support calls and
s from North American electricians and installers during our support window. Diagnose
 pixel data problems, DMX addressing, voltage drop, controller setup, warranty issues.

- Write the fix down so the same call doesn't come back. Knowledge base articles, checklists, short videos.

- Between calls, produce wiring diagrams and fixture layouts in AutoCAD from our design lead's markups, and build the costed bill of materials that goes with them.



YOU NEED

- 2+ years in technical support, field service or commissioning for LED lighting, lighting controls, AV or similar low-voltage electronics

- Working knowledge of DMX512 addressing and topology, SPI pixel basics, and low-voltage DC power. We'll test this.

- AutoCAD, well enough to turn a markup into a clean electrical schematic

- Spoken English you can run a troubleshooting call with. Our callers are electricians on job sites, on bad connections, behind schedule. You'll do a live phone screen.

- Daily use of AI tools in your work. Show us how, don't tell us.

- Full availability for the fixed shift above



NOT A FIT IF

- You want a drafting job with a few calls. This is a phone job with drafting in the gaps.

- You get rattled by a frustrated caller.

- You need a script.



TO APPLY

Put the word PIXEL in your first line. Then send: (1) a 2-minute video of you explaining voltage drop on a 12V LED run to an electrician who's never heard the term, (2) one wiring diagram or schematic you drew yourself. Applications without both won't be reviewed.

title: Video Editors & Animators for Long-Term Work — Pick ONE Track (Skilled Only)
description:
I run a portfolio of YouTube channels — historical documentaries, long-form sleep narration, and 2D animation. I'm not hiring for one single role. I'm building a small pool of skilled people I can assign to different projects depending on what each person is genuinely good at.



This is long-term, ongoing work. If you're good, you'll have steady projects for months and years, not a one-off gig.



Three tracks — apply for ONE only



Pick the one you're strongest at. Applications that claim all three go to the bottom of the pile. I'd rather hire a specialist than a generalist who's mediocre at everything.



TRACK 1 — Long-Form Sleep Content



Calm, slow, atmospheric videos of 2-3 hours built on narration. Think ambient historical imagery, gentle transitions, no jump cuts, no sudden volume changes. The whole point is that the viewer falls asleep and never gets jolted awake.



You need to understand:



Pacing that stays hypnotic for hours without getting boring

Seamless, slow transitions and long holds on single images

Audio mixing where the voice sits softly over ambient beds — consistent loudness, zero spikes

Working efficiently at this length. If a 2-hour video takes you three weeks, this isn't for you.



TRACK 2 — History Documentary Videos (15-60 minutes)



Narrated historical documentaries built largely from AI-generated footage and imagery. Cinematic, atmospheric, driven by the script.



You need to understand:



Cutting to voiceover — matching every visual to what's being said, with rhythm

AI video tools: Higgsfield, Kling, Midjourney, Runway, Veo or similar. Prompting, shot consistency, and knowing how to hide or fix AI artifacts

Sound design, music selection, and building tension and atmosphere

Text overlays, maps, and simple motion graphics where the script calls for it



TRACK 3 — 2D Animation / Stickman Videos



Animated explainer and story videos with simple character styles, including stickman animation.



You need to understand:



Character animation with actual timing and personality, not just sliding assets across the screen

After Effects, Moho, Toon Boom or equivalent

Working from a script and a defined house style, and staying consistent with it across episodes

Motion graphics, lip sync where needed, and clean scene transitions



Requirements (all tracks)



Real portfolio with finished work I can watch. No portfolio, no reply.

Professional level. I'm not looking for someone learning on my projects.

Reliable communication and you hit deadlines. If something goes wrong, you tell me before the deadline, not after.

Comfortable working from a script and a style reference, and taking feedback without rebuilding everything from scratch.

Your own software and a machine that handles the work.



What I offer



Above-market pay for people who deliver. I'd rather pay one good editor well than manage three cheap ones.

Consistent volume — I publish regularly across multiple channels.

Clear briefs: you get the script, the visual direction, and reference material. No guessing.

Room to grow into more responsibility if you prove yourself.



How to apply



Start your application with TRACK 1, TRACK 2, or TRACK 3 so I know which one you're applying for and that you read this.



Then send me:



Why that track is your strongest — be specific.

Links to 2-3 finished pieces relevant to that track. Tell me exactly what your contribution was on each.

The tools and software you work with.

Your rate (per hour, per video, or per finished minute — your choice) and how many hours a week you're available.

Your timezone.



Applications without a portfolio link or without a track number get deleted unread.

title: Accounting Assistant — Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable
description:
Virtual Accounting Assistant — Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



Company: Chaz

Location: Remote

Schedule: 25 hours a week, with consistent availability and agreed-upon overlap during Pacific Time business hours [either 8am-11am or 2pm-5pm PST], 5/hours a day, Monday-Friday PST. 

Reports to: Chaz ownership and/or designated accounting supervisor



About Chaz



Chaz is a Ventura, California-based distributor of foodservice supplies, packaging, and janitorial and sanitation products. We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Accounting Assistant to help keep our accounts payable and accounts receivable organized, accurate, and current.



This is a hands-on accounting support role—not a general administrative assistant position. You will manage our shared accounting inbox, maintain records in our Entrée ERP system and BILL (
), respond to customer and vendor requests, reconcile vendor accounts, follow up on overdue customer invoices, and track accounting tasks in Asana.



The right person is comfortable working independently, handling confidential financial information, and following established procedures. You should be able to identify discrepancies, investigate missing information, and communicate clearly when an issue requires review.



Key Responsibilities

Shared Accounting Inbox Management



Monitor our shared accounting
 inbox throughout your scheduled workday. Review and organize incoming invoices, credit memos, payment notifications, vendor statements, customer requests, and other accounting correspondence.



Respond professionally to routine requests, route questions requiring approval to the appropriate Chaz employee, and make sure outstanding items have a clear next step. Requests that require additional work or follow-up must be tracked in Asana rather than left unresolved in the inbox.



Accounts Payable Support



Enter or upload vendor invoices and credit memos into BILL, including the appropriate supporting documentation, according to Chaz’s procedures. Verify the vendor, invoice number, invoice date, amount, and payment terms, and check for duplicate entries before saving.



Follow up on missing invoices, missing credit memos, and incomplete documentation. Maintain organized records and bring unresolved discrepancies to the attention of the Chaz accounting supervisor.



A Chaz employee will review and approve outgoing payments. This position does not independently approve or release payments.



Monthly Vendor Reconciliations



Complete monthly vendor statement reconciliations to confirm that all vendor invoices and credits have been entered into BILL and that payment activity is properly reflected.



Compare vendor statements with the records in BILL. Identify missing invoices, unrecorded credits, duplicate entries, unapplied payments, and differences in outstanding balances.



Request missing documentation from vendors, enter verified invoices and credits, and maintain an organized record of each reconciliation. Provide Chaz with a clear summary of completed reconciliations, outstanding differences, and items requiring a decision or follow-up.



Accounts Receivable and Customer Billing Support



Enter or upload customer invoices from Entrée ERP into BILL on the schedule established by Chaz. Verify that customer information, invoice numbers, dates, amounts, payment terms, and supporting documents are accurate and that invoices are not entered twice.



Respond to customer
 requests for invoice copies and account statements. Retrieve the requested information from Entrée ERP, verify that it relates to the correct account, and send it to the appropriate customer contact.



Keep customer billing and payment records current, and flag billing questions, disputed balances, or payment discrepancies for Chaz review.



Payment Entry and Verification



Enter customer payments into Entrée ERP according to Chaz’s established procedures. Payment notifications will arrive in the accounting inbox, and you will also have access to BILL to review payment activity directly in the platform.



Verify the correct customer, invoice numbers, payment amount, payment date, and reference information before posting. Apply payments to the appropriate invoices, check for duplicate entries, and flag partial payments, overpayments, unidentified payments, or other discrepancies for review.



Distinguish between scheduled, completed, failed, and canceled payments, and follow Chaz’s procedures for when each should be recorded. Do not assume that a payment has been completed simply because it has been scheduled



Accounts Receivable Reporting and Past-Due Follow-Up



Run the accounts receivable aging report from Entrée ERP on Chaz’s established schedule. Review outstanding balances, identify past-due invoices, and determine which accounts require follow-up under Chaz’s procedures.



Review recent payments, credits, and customer correspondence before sending reminders to avoid contacting customers about invoices that have already been paid or otherwise resolved.



 customers about overdue invoices using Chaz-approved templates and procedures. Clearly communicate the outstanding invoice numbers, amounts, and due dates, provide invoice copies or statements as needed, and request a payment status update or expected payment date.



Document customer responses, promised payment dates, billing questions, and next steps in Asana. Follow up on missed payment commitments and continue tracking each issue until payment is verified or the issue is otherwise resolved through Chaz’s approval process. Sending a reminder alone does not mean the follow-up task is complete.



Escalate disputed invoices, repeated nonresponses, missed payment commitments, and other concerns to the Chaz accounting supervisor according to established procedures. Payment plans, extensions of payment terms, write-offs, and account holds require approval from an authorized Chaz employee.



All customer communication should be courteous, clear, and consistent—protecting customer relationships while ensuring overdue balances receive timely attention.



Asana Task Management



Use Asana to create, organize, update, and complete accounting tasks. Track recurring billing schedules, monthly vendor reconciliations, missing documents, unresolved discrepancies, customer requests, past-due invoice follow-up, and payment commitments.



Maintain clear task descriptions, owners, due dates, status updates, and supporting information. Identify when a task is waiting on a vendor, customer, or Chaz employee, and follow up appropriately.



Mark tasks complete only after the required work is finished and the relevant accounting records have been updated. Ensure that unresolved issues remain visible and have a documented next action.



Required Qualifications

Hands-on accounts payable and accounts receivable experience, including entering invoices and credits, applying payments, reconciling vendor statements, and reviewing accounts receivable aging reports.

Experience with BILL (
) and an ERP or accounting system, including reviewing payment activity and maintaining accurate transaction records.

Experience following up on overdue customer invoices by
, requesting payment updates, documenting commitments, and escalating unresolved balances appropriately.

Strong written English and professional
 communication, with the ability to respond clearly and courteously to customers, vendors, and internal team members.

Excellent accuracy, organization, and follow-through, including the ability to meet recurring deadlines, investigate discrepancies, and work independently without making unsupported assumptions.

Comfort with Asana or a similar task-management platform and Excel or Google Sheets, along with reliable internet access and a secure remote workspace.



Experience with Entrée ERP or an ERP system, distribution or wholesale businesses, shared accounting inboxes, and recurring invoice-entry workflows is preferred.



What Success Looks Like



Accounting records are accurate and updated on schedule. Customers and vendors receive timely responses, and unresolved issues do not get lost in the inbox.



Customer invoices are entered into BILL according to the established billing schedule. Payments are applied to the correct accounts and invoices without duplication. Monthly vendor reconciliations are completed by the agreed deadline, with missing invoices, credits, and balance differences either resolved or clearly documented.



Accounts receivable reports are reviewed on schedule, past-due customers receive timely and accurate reminders, and payment commitments are tracked through resolution. Chaz has clear visibility into overdue balances, disputed invoices, and accounts requiring management attention.



Asana provides an accurate view of what is complete, what remains outstanding, who is responsible for the next action, and when follow-up is due.



Accuracy is more important than speed alone. We expect you to ask questions and flag uncertainty rather than guess or make unsupported adjustments.



Confidentiality and Approval Boundaries



You will handle confidential customer, vendor, and company financial information and must follow Chaz’s security and access procedures.



This role is responsible for preparing, entering, verifying, reconciling, communicating, and tracking accounting information. Outgoing payment approvals and releases, refunds, write-offs, customer credit adjustments, payment arrangements, account holds, and changes to banking information remain subject to Chaz’s designated approval process.



Suspicious payment instructions or requests to change banking details must be escalated rather than acted on independently.



Schedule: 

We require 2–3 hours of overlap each workday with our California team, within our 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Pacific Time business hours. We are flexible about the specific overlap window and will agree on a consistent schedule before your start date. Morning or Late-afternoon California overlap is preferred.



The remaining hours can be scheduled flexibly around established daily responsibilities and deadlines. Please include your preferred overlap hours in both California time and Philippine time when applying



How to Apply



Please submit your résumé and a brief introduction describing your accounts payable and accounts receivable experience. Include the systems you have used—particularly BILL, Entrée ERP or different ERP, and Asana—your weekly availability, your availability during Pacific Time business hours, and your expected hourly rate.



Please also answer the following two questions:



Vendor reconciliation: A vendor statement lists an invoice and a credit memo that are both missing from BILL. What steps would you take to investigate, resolve, and document the discrepancy?



Past-due customer follow-up: A customer’s invoice appears overdue on the accounts receivable aging report, but the customer says they already paid. What would you check before responding, and how would you document and track the issue?

title: Ecommerce Operations Assistant
description:
To be considered, please complete our official application: 
 — this is the only way to move forward.



Ecommerce Operations Assistant

Full-Time · Remote



About AUGO

Take life to go.

That’s what AUGO is about. For the mom whose back door is always open with kids and dogs running through. For the off-roader strapping his ATV onto the truck. For families, adventurers, and everyone in between — AUGO is built to come with you.

We’re a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling durable, practical products across home and outdoor categories — including our magnetic screen doors and retractable ratchet straps. We’ve built a strong Amazon business with thousands of 5-star reviews, and we’re now scaling onto TikTok Shop, Shopify, and international marketplaces.

To keep growing at pace, we need someone who can execute across the entire operation.



The Role

We’re hiring a full-time Ecommerce Operations Assistant to be the tactical backbone of our team.

This is a shared role — you’ll support multiple department heads across Amazon operations, customer service, multi-platform store management, pricing, and light sourcing. You won’t be siloed to one area. You’ll be the reason customer messages get answered fast, listings stay healthy, pricing stays consistent across platforms, and the operation runs smoothly across countries.

You’ll report to the team through a shared task queue. Priorities are set collaboratively each week. Your job is to execute — cleanly, quickly, and with the kind of attention to detail that makes department heads want to keep giving you more.

If you love variety, ownership, and being trusted across an entire operation, this role is for you.



What You’ll Own

Amazon Listing Monitoring & Support Monitor Amazon listing health across our catalog. Flag issues as they happen — Buy Box loss, suppressed listings, content violations, low inventory alerts. Support listing updates when needed (titles, bullets, descriptions, images). Back up the team on keyword research and backend search terms.

Customer Service Across Channels Respond to Amazon customer messages within 24 hours. Handle the customer email inbox at 
 Amazon Q&A responses. Escalate complex issues to the right department head. Track recurring issues so we can fix them upstream.

Multi-Platform Store Management Support our Shopify store — product info, imagery, promotions, and updates. Support TikTok Shop backend maintenance. Coordinate updates across platforms so everything stays consistent.

Pricing Across Platforms & Countries Keep pricing accurate and aligned across Amazon (US + international marketplaces), Shopify, TikTok Shop, and any other channels we launch on. Maintain pricing sheets in Google Sheets. Roll out coordinated pricing changes when the team makes them.

Image Work & Content Support Basic image editing in Canva or Photoshop. Prepare listing images to spec across platforms. Support A+ content and promotional graphics when needed.

Sourcing Research Basic supplier research on Alibaba and 1688. Build vendor comparison spreadsheets. Coordinate sample tracking. You’re not negotiating deals — you’re building the data department heads need to negotiate.

Data & Reporting Support Data entry into internal systems. Compile weekly reports across platforms. Ad-hoc analysis for department heads as needed.



What Success Looks Like

•             Monitor Amazon listing health across the catalog — flag issues within 24 hours

•             Resolve customer messages within 24 hours across Amazon + email inbox (95%+ hit rate)

•             Handle 50+ customer service touches per week solo across all channels

•             Keep pricing accurate and aligned across all platforms + country marketplaces

•             Complete Shopify store updates on schedule

•             Zero escalations on standard operational work after month 1

•             Complete first end-to-end sourcing research assignment by month 2

•             Positive feedback from at least 2 department heads by month 3

•             100% attendance and reliability during first 90 days



30 / 60 / 90 Day Plan

First 30 Days — Foundations & Onboarding

•             Learn AUGO’s products, brand voice, and platform footprint (Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, international marketplaces)

•             Master our tools: Amazon Seller Central, Helium 10, Shopify admin, Canva, Google Drive, customer email inbox, VA Task Queue

•             Meet each department head via 15-min intro Loom

•             Assist on 2 real listing monitoring / update tasks (paired review before publish)

•             Handle 10 customer messages/day with review across Amazon + email

Days 31–60 — Own Cross-Department Work

•             Take ownership of Amazon listing monitoring solo

•             Handle 30–50 customer messages/week solo across Amazon + email

•             Take ownership of pricing consistency across platforms

•             Complete first Shopify store update project

•             Complete first image editing assignment

•             Complete first sourcing research task

•             Begin weekly async check-ins with department heads

Days 61–90 — Optimize & Scale

•             Full ownership of customer inbox at scale (50+/week)

•             Full ownership of Amazon listing health monitoring

•             Own pricing coordination across all platforms

•             Deliver Shopify updates on schedule

•             Complete cross-department sourcing projects

•             Flag process improvements and help refine SOPs



Required Experience

•             1+ year direct hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience — non-negotiable

•             Experience monitoring or managing e-commerce listings

•             Prior customer service background

•             Comfortable managing tasks from multiple stakeholders



Required Skills

•             Near-native written English (9+/10 self-rating)

•             Amazon Seller Central proficiency

•             Customer service written communication

•             Google Workspace proficiency (Sheets, Docs, Drive)

•             Basic Canva or Photoshop

•             Detail-oriented, organized, comfortable multi-tasking

•             Reliable time zone overlap with US Eastern (3–4 hrs/day minimum)



Nice to Have (Not Required)

•             Shopify backend familiarity

•             TikTok Shop backend familiarity

•             Amazon PPC / advertising familiarity

•             Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, or similar tools

•             Alibaba / 1688 sourcing experience

•             International marketplace experience (Amazon EU, UK, CA, AU)

•             Basic spreadsheet formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH)

•             A+ content design experience



Who You Are

•             Self-directed within clear priorities

•             Comfortable receiving tasks from multiple department heads — you don’t get overwhelmed by multi-tasking, you find rhythm in it

•             Strong prioritization judgment — you know what to do first

•             Proactive communicator who flags blockers early

•             Handles pressure well

•             Owns your work — doesn’t wait for permission

•             Team-oriented — you’re comfortable being a shared resource, not a solo hire



Benefits & Culture — Why You’ll Thrive at AUGO

Cross-Functional Exposure Most VA roles pigeonhole you into one narrow area. This one gives you access to every part of the operation — Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, customer service, pricing, sourcing, cross-country work. You’ll learn how an entire e-commerce brand actually runs from the inside.

Direct Line to the Team You’ll work directly with the founder and multiple department heads. No corporate red tape, no committee approvals, no waiting weeks for direction. Real feedback, real answers, real ownership.

A Brand With Proven Traction Thousands of 5-star reviews on Amazon. We’re not a startup guessing at product-market fit — we’re a proven brand scaling across new channels, new countries, and new categories. Your work compounds on real 
ntum.

Real Impact Across Departments Your work moves the needle in customer satisfaction, listing health, pricing accuracy, cross-platform consistency, sourcing costs — everywhere. You’ll see your contribution in real business results, every week.

Growth Path Prove yourself here and there’s room to grow — into specialist tracks (Amazon operations, customer experience, sourcing, international expansion), team lead roles, or department support as AUGO scales.

Fully Remote Work from wherever you’re most productive. All you need is reliable internet, US Eastern time zone overlap, and the discipline to show up every day.

Mission-Driven AUGO is about helping families and adventurers take life to go. You’ll be growing a brand that genuinely makes people’s lives easier — that shows up in every 5-star review, every returning customer, every review that says “buying another one for my in-laws.”

title: Customer Service Manager
description:
Email Support Lead → CS Manager — Fast-Growing Multi-Brand DTC Operation (Part-Time, Long-Term)



This is not a "reply to tickets" job — it's the entry point to running our entire customer support department.



We run 10+ direct-to-consumer brands on Shopify across the US, UK, Australia, and Canada, scaling aggressively on paid acquisition. Customer support is a revenue function here — your replies directly impact refund rates, chargeback ratios, and repeat purchase behavior. If you see CS as "answering
s," this isn't for you.



The path:



You start as our
 support lead — handling tickets across multiple brands, owning quality, and learning our systems inside out. Once you've proven you can run the day-to-day without supervision, the role grows into CS Manager: hiring and training new reps, building SOPs for new stores as we launch them, owning KPIs across the department, and reporting directly to the founders. We promote from within — our current operations manager started in a similar role.



What makes this role different:



You'll own
 support across multiple brands, each with its own tone, policies, and customer base. You'll work from detailed SOPs and refund decision trees — but we expect you to think, not just follow scripts. When a flow breaks or a new edge case appears, you flag it, propose a fix, and help us improve the system. You report directly to our operations manager with a structured daily end-of-shift report.



You're the right person if:



- You've done
 CS for at least 2 years in DTC e-commerce — not SaaS, not call centers, not marketplace seller support. Direct-to-consumer, physical products, paid traffic. You know what a chargeback costs and why a well-timed partial refund beats a full one.

- You want to manage, not just execute. You've caught yourself thinking "I would run this team differently" at a previous job. You notice inefficiencies before they're pointed out.

- You live in Shopify. Order lookups, refund processing, editing orders, checking fulfillment timelines — this is muscle memory, not something you need to Google.

- You've used Re:amaze, Gorgias, or Zendesk professionally. Re:amaze is strongly preferred.

- Your written English is sharp. Not "good for a non-native speaker" — actually sharp. Clear, warm, concise. No templates that sound like a robot. We'll know in 30 seconds from your application.

- You can juggle 8+ brand accounts without sending the wrong macro to the wrong customer.

- You're online when you say you'll be online. Consistent schedule, camera-off is fine, but disappearing mid-shift isn't.



What you won't find here:



- Micromanagement. SOPs exist so we don't have to hover.

- A dead-end role. We're growing fast and need leaders, not seat-fillers.

- Chaos without structure. Every store has documented flows, refund matrices, and escalation paths.



What we expect in return:



- Ownership. If something is broken, you say so — you don't wait for someone to notice.

- Precision. Wrong refund amount, wrong store reply, wrong tone — these cost real money. We track quality weekly.

- Initiative. You see a pattern in tickets? You draft the SOP update. A new rep keeps making the same mistake? You build the training. That's the mindset that earns the manager title.

- Daily EOD report in Slack. Non-negotiable — no report, no pay for that shift.



Stack: Shopify · Re:amaze · Slack



Budget: $5–7/hr starting, with structured raises tied to performance milestones. Part-time with a consistent weekly schedule, with potential to grow to full-time as the role expands. This is a long-term position — we're building a department, not plugging a hole.



To apply — do these three things or you'll be ignored:



1. Tell us about your e-commerce CS experience without naming brands if you prefer — how many stores did you handle simultaneously, what helpdesk(s) did you use, what was your average ticket volume per shift, and what types of products/niches did you support (e.g. fashion, health, home goods)?



2. Write a reply to this customer
:



"Hi, I ordered this 3 weeks ago and it still hasn't arrived. I've
ed twice and nobody got back to me. At this point I just want my money back. This is ridiculous."



Write it as if you're replying from a small family-run brand that sells handmade leather bags. Keep it under 100 words.



3. Describe one time you improved a CS process at a previous job — what was broken, what you did, and what changed. Three sentences max.

title: Freelance Video Editor YouTube Long-Form + Short-Form Content
description:
I am looking for a talented freelance video editor to join my content team and help take my YouTube and short-form content to the next level.



I am a travel and lifestyle content creator with 10+ years of experience creating online content. I create content around travel, lifestyle, family, work, personal experiences, and day-to-day life.



I currently have an established YouTube channel, but I am intentionally looking to evolve my editing style and format. I want my videos to feel more engaging, dynamic, entertaining, and modern.



I have ideas for the direction I want to take the channel, but I am also looking for an editor who can bring creative ideas and strong storytelling instincts to the table.



This is not simply a “cut my footage together” position.



I want an editor who understands pacing, storytelling, viewer retention, music, visual interest, and creating an overall experience for the viewer.



TYPES OF CONTENT



You should be comfortable editing both:



Long-Form YouTube Content



* Talking-head videos

* Travel vlogs

* Day-in-the-life videos

* Travel experiences

* Lifestyle content

* Story-driven videos

* Sit-down/commentary content

* Videos combining multiple filming locations and types of footage



Final long-form videos will generally be approximately 20–60 minutes.



Short-Form Content



* YouTube Shorts

* TikTok

* Pinterest

* Vertical social media content



Short-form videos will generally range from approximately 30 seconds to 3 minutes.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



You will be responsible for taking organized raw footage and turning it into polished, engaging, platform-ready content.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing and understanding the creative brief

* Creating a strong opening hook

* Cutting and organizing footage

* Removing unnecessary, repetitive, or slow sections

* Creating strong pacing

* Building a cohesive story from raw footage

* Selecting and incorporating B-roll

* Creating transitions where appropriate

* Selecting music

* Syncing music with the pacing and emotion of the video

* Adding voice-over

* Adding on-screen text

* Adding captions/subtitles when appropriate

* Creating graphics and visual callouts

* Adding zooms, punch-ins, overlays, and other visual elements when appropriate

* Basic sound design

* Cleaning up dialogue/audio

* Basic color correction and grading

* Creating an engaging viewing experience without over-editing

* Formatting videos appropriately for each platform

* Exporting final videos in the correct specifications

* Making revisions based on feedback



CREATIVE EXPECTATIONS



I’m specifically looking for an editor who understands that good editing is about more than transitions.



I want someone who can recognize when a video is:



* Moving too slowly

* Repetitive

* Missing visual interest

* Missing context

* Too long

* Too quiet

* Too heavily edited

* Not telling the story clearly



You should be comfortable making creative recommendations when you see an opportunity to improve the video.



I will provide a creative brief for each project that will include the overall concept, flow, and desired feeling of the video.



As we develop a working relationship and you become familiar with my brand and audience, I would like to give the right editor increasing creative freedom.



MUSIC



I have memberships with LICKD and Artlist, so you will have access to a large library of music options.



You will be responsible for selecting appropriate music for each project and making sure the music supports the pacing, mood, and story.



WORKFLOW



My Virtual Assistant will handle the initial organization of footage before you receive it.



They will:



* Trim obvious unusable footage

* Organize clips

* Label footage

* Prepare files according to our workflow



You will then receive:



* Organized footage

* A creative brief

* An overview of the video’s desired flow

* The overall tone/feel

* Any specific creative direction or requirements



Your job is to take those materials and turn them into the finished video.



TURNAROUND TIME



Turnaround time is extremely important.



Long-form videos:

48 hours for the initial edit



Short-form videos:

24 hours for the initial edit



Revisions:

All requested revisions should be completed within 24 hours.



Our goal is for content to be fully edited, revised, exported, and platform-ready within 72 hours of receiving the footage/brief.



If you anticipate that a deadline cannot be met, communication is expected as early as possible.



EXPECTED MONTHLY VOLUME



To start, the expected workload will generally be:



Long-form:

1–2 videos per month



Final videos will generally be approximately 20–60 minutes.



Short-form:

2–4 videos per month



Short-form videos will generally be approximately 30 seconds–3 minutes.



This volume may increase as the channel grows and our workflow develops.



This is intended to be a long-term freelance relationship for the right editor.



SOFTWARE



You are responsible for providing your own video editing software and equipment.



You may use whatever professional editing software you prefer, including but not limited to:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Final Cut Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Other professional editing platforms



Please indicate what software you use and your level of experience with it when applying.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



The ideal editor will have:



* Strong storytelling instincts

* Excellent pacing

* A good understanding of YouTube

* Experience editing talking-head content

* Experience editing travel/vlog/lifestyle content

* Experience creating short-form vertical content

* Strong music selection instincts

* Strong understanding of B-roll

* Good audio editing skills

* Basic color correction/grading skills

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent communication

* Ability to meet deadlines consistently

* Ability to take creative direction

* Ability to make creative recommendations

* Ability to work independently

* Strong organizational skills

* An understanding of what makes content engaging and watchable



Most importantly, I want someone who can help me evolve my content style.



I’m not looking for an editor who simply does exactly what every other editor is doing.



I want someone who can bring ideas to the table while still understanding my brand, personality, and audience.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED



Applicants should have experience editing both:



1. Talking-head videos

2. Travel, vlog, lifestyle, or day-in-the-life content



Applicants who only have experience editing one style may not be the right fit for this position.

ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking a reliable and technically strong **WordPress Developer & SEO Website Manager** to take primary responsibility for the ongoing health, maintenance, security, and performance of our WordPress websites and hosting environment.



The most important responsibility of this role is keeping our websites and server environment properly maintained and proactively identifying issues before they become larger problems.



You will regularly work inside **WP Engine** to monitor and maintain our WordPress sites, update WordPress core, themes, plugins, and PHP versions, test websites after updates, monitor for security or performance issues, and work directly with WP Engine support when hosting or technical problems arise.



In addition to technical website maintenance, you will make routine content updates, publish blog posts, optimize website pages for SEO and AI search visibility, and assist with other WordPress development needs as they arise.



You will work directly with our project leadership team and receive clear priorities, written instructions, and ongoing direction. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, communicates proactively, tests their work carefully, and alerts the team quickly when they identify technical, security, hosting, or website issues.



This is a hands-on website management role, not simply a support or ticket-response position.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



WordPress Maintenance & Website Health



Your primary responsibility will be keeping our WordPress websites secure, updated, stable, and functioning properly.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor and maintain all WordPress websites on an ongoing basis.

* Keep WordPress core versions current.

* Update WordPress themes and plugins.

* Monitor and update PHP versions as needed.

* Test websites thoroughly after updates.

* Identify plugin conflicts, broken functionality, display issues, or errors.

* Monitor website speed, uptime, and overall technical health.

* Check for outdated or unsupported plugins and themes.

* Identify potential website or server security concerns.

* Proactively communicate technical issues, risks, or recommendations.

* Maintain backups and confirm restoration options are available when needed.

* Troubleshoot issues before escalating when possible.

* Document significant maintenance, updates, or technical changes.



WP Engine Hosting Management



A significant part of this role involves working directly inside WP Engine.



You will:



* Manage development, staging, and production environments.

* Perform website backups and restores.

* Push changes between staging and production environments.

* Review WP Engine technical alerts and recommendations.

* Troubleshoot website and hosting issues.

* Work directly with **WP Engine support** when problems require hosting-level assistance.

* Follow up with support until issues are fully resolved.

* Monitor PHP compatibility and hosting requirements.

* Investigate server errors, performance issues, caching problems, SSL issues, DNS-related problems, and other hosting concerns.

* Clearly communicate the issue, resolution, and any recommended next steps to our team.



We need someone who is comfortable reaching out to technical support rather than allowing unresolved hosting issues to remain open.



WEBSITE SECURITY



You will help maintain the security of all websites and proactively identify potential vulnerabilities.



Responsibilities may include:



* Monitor website security using tools such as **Wordfence**.

* Identify suspicious login attempts or website activity.

* Conduct routine plugin and theme security reviews.

* Remove or replace outdated or vulnerable plugins.

* Assist with credential management and password updates.

* Monitor SSL certificates and website security warnings.

* Investigate malware, redirects, spam, or suspicious website behavior.

* Escalate security concerns immediately.

* Coordinate with WP Engine support or other vendors when needed.



WEBSITE CONTENT UPDATES



You will also be responsible for routine website updates requested by our team or clients.



This may include:



* Updating website copy.

* Replacing images.

* Adding or updating team members.

* Updating services or product information.

* Creating or modifying website pages.

* Updating forms and calls to action.

* Updating navigation menus.

* Adding downloadable resources.

* Making layout or formatting changes.

* Troubleshooting broken links or website elements.



You should be comfortable working with WordPress builders and frameworks including:



* Elementor

* Avada

* Gutenberg

* ACF

* Custom WordPress themes

* PHP, HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript



BLOG PUBLISHING



You will publish blog content provided by our marketing or content teams.



Responsibilities include:



* Format and publish WordPress blog posts.

* Apply proper heading hierarchy.

* Add and optimize images.

* Add internal and external links.

* Add calls to action.

* Configure categories and tags.

* Create appropriate URLs.

* Add featured images.

* Optimize blog posts for desktop and mobile.

* Check posts before publication.

* Confirm links and formatting are working correctly.



SEO & AI SEARCH OPTIMIZATION



You will help ensure website pages and blog posts follow current SEO and AI-search best practices.



Responsibilities include:



* Optimize page titles and meta descriptions.

* Review heading structure.

* Optimize URLs.

* Add image alt text.

* Improve internal linking.

* Implement schema and structured data where appropriate.

* Work with plugins such as **Yoast SEO or RankMath**.

* Monitor indexing and website errors in Google Search Console.

* Assist with keyword optimization.

* Review technical SEO issues.

* Apply **AIO, AEO, and GEO** best practices.

* Structure content for visibility within:



  * Google Search

  * Google AI Overviews

  * ChatGPT

  * Other AI-powered search and answer engines



This may include implementing:



* FAQ schema

* HowTo schema

* Answer-first content structures

* Clear heading hierarchy

* Structured data

* Internal entity relationships

* Improved crawlability and content clarity



Experience with tools such as SEMrush, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console is preferred.



WORDPRESS DEVELOPMENT



While this role is primarily focused on website maintenance and management, you should also be comfortable handling development tasks when needed.



This may include:



* Building new WordPress pages.

* Modifying website templates.

* Creating or editing reusable modules.

* Working with ACF custom fields.

* Making PHP, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript updates.

* Troubleshooting theme or plugin code.

* Working with GitHub repositories.

* Creating branches and pull requests.

* Testing changes in staging environments.

* Implementing third-party integrations.

* Connecting websites with CRM, booking, scheduling, or marketing platforms.



API & PLATFORM INTEGRATIONS



Experience working with APIs and integrations is important.



You may work with platforms such as:



* GoHighLevel

* Booking and scheduling platforms

* CRM systems

*
 marketing platforms

* Lead-generation forms

* Zapier or similar automation platforms

* Google services

* Analytics and tracking systems



Direct experience with GoHighLevel is a strong advantage.



USING AI TOOLS



We actively use AI tools to increase productivity and expect our developer to be comfortable doing the same.



Tools may include:



* ChatGPT

* Claude / Claude Code

* GitHub Copilot

* Cursor

* Other AI development tools



AI may be used to:



* Troubleshoot WordPress problems.

* Analyze code.

* Debug plugin conflicts.

* Develop PHP, CSS, or JavaScript.

* Research technical solutions.

* Improve SEO implementation.

* Assist with schema and structured data.

* Speed up repetitive development work.



You must still understand, review, test, and take responsibility for everything you deploy.



REQUIRED SKILLS



We are looking for someone with:



* 3+ years of hands-on WordPress experience

* Strong experience maintaining live WordPress websites

* Experience managing WordPress core, themes, plugins, and PHP updates

* Experience working inside **WP Engine or a similar managed WordPress hosting platform**

* Strong troubleshooting skills

* WordPress security experience

* Understanding of backups, staging environments, and production deployments

* Experience with Elementor, Avada, Gutenberg, ACF, or custom themes

* Working knowledge of PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

* Experience with Yoast, RankMath, or similar SEO tools

* On-page and technical SEO experience

* Understanding of AIO, AEO, GEO, or AI-search optimization

* Experience with Google Search Console

* Experience working with APIs or third-party integrations

* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub

* Experience using AI tools in real development work

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to test your work before reporting that it is complete

* Strong troubleshooting and research skills

* Good written and conversational English

* Ability to communicate technical issues clearly to non-technical team members



NICE-TO-HAVE EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* GoHighLevel

* WP Engine

* Wordfence

* Advanced Custom Fields

* Sage / Blade WordPress framework

* WPML

* SEMrush

* Google Analytics

* Google Search Console

* Google Tag Manager

* Schema markup

* Core Web Vitals

* Canva

* Notion

* Website accessibility

* Conversion tracking

* CRM integrations

* Marketing landing pages

* DNS and domain management

* Cloudflare



THE WORK STYLE WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, and takes ownership of website health.



You should:



* Check websites carefully rather than waiting for users to report problems.

* Proactively identify technical or security concerns.

* Notify the team quickly when an issue is discovered.

* Follow through until problems are resolved.

* Contact WP Engine or other technical support teams when needed.

* Test updates before considering work complete.

* Communicate clearly about what was changed.

* Document important technical work.

* Ask thoughtful questions when instructions are unclear.

* Research unfamiliar problems rather than immediately giving up.

* Be comfortable learning new systems.

* Accept feedback professionally.

* Follow established processes.

* Take responsibility for assigned work.



We value someone who says, “I found an issue, here is what I discovered, here is what I have already done, and here is what I recommend next,” rather than simply reporting that something is broken.



HOURS & WORKING ARRANGEMENT



* Full-time contractor position

* Fully remote

* Philippines-based candidates preferred

* Full-time working hours required

* Some flexibility in how you structure your workday

* Availability for scheduled team meetings

* Regular overlap with **Houston, Texas Central Time business hours**

* Reliable high-speed internet required

* Professional environment suitable for Google Meet and team calls



Full-time contractor position.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following with your application:



1. Your name and location.

2. A brief summary of your WordPress experience.

3. How many years you have professionally managed or developed WordPress websites.

4. Your experience managing WordPress updates, including core, themes, plugins, and PHP.

5. Your experience working with WP Engine or another managed WordPress hosting provider.

6. An example of a serious website, hosting, plugin, or security issue you identified and how you resolved it.

7. Links to **3–5 WordPress websites** you have developed or substantially managed, along with an explanation of your responsibilities.

8. Your experience with Elementor, Avada, Gutenberg, ACF, PHP, or custom WordPress themes.

9. Your experience with Wordfence or other website security tools.

10. Your SEO experience, including Yoast, RankMath, Search Console, SEMrush, schema, or technical SEO.

11. Your understanding or experience with AIO, AEO, GEO, or AI-search optimization.

12. Your experience working with APIs or third-party integrations.

13. Your experience with GoHighLevel, if applicable.

14. Which AI development tools you use and one specific example of how you used AI to solve a real technical problem.

15. Your current availability and confirmation that you are seeking full-time work.

16. Your availability to overlap with Houston, Texas Central Time.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a reliable long-term member of our team and taking ownership of the technical health of our websites.



If you enjoy maintaining WordPress websites, solving technical problems, improving website performance and security, and proactively keeping sites running smoothly, we would like to hear from you.

title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

You will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Monitor lanes and critical loads with urgency, accuracy, and consistency from start to finish.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date information across TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms.

• Provide scheduled updates on time with clear, concise, and actionable communication.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early, bringing solutions and next steps whenever possible.

• Maintain smooth and well-documented shift handoffs, and demonstrate reliability during high-pressure situations.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, transportation tracking, or similar operations, with an understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and Hours of Service.

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and proper prioritization in a live dispatch environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills across Zoom, chat, and
, with a minimum typing speed of 45 WPM.

• Highly detail-oriented with sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to operate effectively in high-volume communication environments.

• Team oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a willingness to follow established processes, accept feedback, and collaborate without resistance or ego.



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Hands-on leadership with direct feedback, coaching, and support.

• Measurable growth opportunities within a scaling freight brokerage.

• Performance recognition with advancement potential for strong contributors.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct hire, full time position with a US based company, and permanent work from home setup.

• Available shift: Monday - Saturday 7 PM - 5 AM CDT

• Zoom presence with camera on and audio unmuted is required throughout the scheduled shift.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance support.



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute lanes with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

title: Appointment Setter - Onyx (GoHighLevel CRM)
description:
Compensation: $3.00/hour + Commission

Schedule: Full Time / Remote

Industry: Life & Mortgage Protection Insurance



Position Overview



We are looking for a reliable, motivated, and detail-oriented Appointment Setter / Virtual Assistant to join our mortgage protection insurance team. This position is responsible for communicating with prospective clients, following up with leads, answering inbound calls, making outbound calls, and scheduling qualified, quality appointments for licensed agents.



The ideal candidate is comfortable communicating with clients through phone calls and text messages, understands the importance of timely follow-up, and can confidently maintain conversations without making the interaction feel overly scripted or sales-focused.



This is a performance-based position. We are looking for someone who is consistent, organized, proactive, coachable, and interested in building a long-term working relationship with the team.



Key Responsibilities



Lead Follow-Up & Communication



Respond to new leads and client inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

Send text messages to leads and maintain consistent follow-up until the lead responds, schedules, or is appropriately dispositioned.

Communicate naturally and professionally rather than relying solely on copy-and-paste responses.

Answer questions within the scope of the position and recognize when a lead should be transferred or escalated to a licensed agent.

Maintain a professional, friendly, and confident tone with prospective clients.



Inbound & Outbound Calling



Answer inbound calls from prospective clients and existing leads.

Make necessary outbound calls to leads who have not responded to texts or require additional follow-up.

Make follow-up calls to previously contacted leads and missed appointments when necessary.

Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows through proper communication and reminders.

Communicate clearly with prospects while maintaining professionalism throughout every interaction.



Appointment Setting



Schedule appointments based on the agent's availability and established scheduling procedures.

Focus on setting quality appointments, not simply filling the calendar with unqualified prospects.

Confirm that the prospect understands the reason for the appointment and is available to speak with the licensed agent.

Collect and verify necessary information before scheduling when applicable.

Follow up with prospects who miss, cancel, or need to reschedule appointments.

Maintain a strong appointment-to-contact and appointment-to-show mindset.

CRM Responsibilities



The Appointment Setter will be expected to become comfortable using CRM systems, including Onyx and GoHighLevel (HighLevel).



Responsibilities include:



Entering and updating lead information accurately.

Properly dispositioning every lead after calls, texts, and follow-ups.

Updating lead statuses based on the outcome of each interaction.

Recording important notes so the agent has sufficient context before speaking with the prospect.

Maintaining organized follow-up pipelines.

Setting reminders and tasks when additional follow-up is required.

Monitoring scheduled appointments and ensuring leads receive appropriate confirmation messages.

Keeping the CRM clean, accurate, and up to date throughout the workday.

Learning and following the team's specific CRM processes and workflows.



CRM accuracy is extremely important. Leads should never be left without a disposition, note, or appropriate next step when one is required.



The ideal candidate should be:



Highly reliable and consistent

Comfortable speaking with people over the phone

A strong written communicator

Comfortable texting prospective clients professionally

Able to respond quickly to new leads and inbound inquiries

Organized and detail-oriented

Comfortable learning and navigating Onyx and GoHighLevel

Able to multitask between calls, texts, CRM updates, and appointment scheduling

Coachable and willing to learn the team's processes

Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

Comfortable handling basic objections and keeping conversations moving

Able to recognize when a prospect is genuinely interested versus simply giving a low-quality appointment

Capable of working independently while remaining accountable to performance expectations

Quality Over Quantity



Our goal is not simply to schedule as many appointments as possible. Appointment quality matters.



Successful candidates will be expected to:



Consistently follow up with assigned leads.

Respond to new inquiries within a reasonable timeframe.

Maintain accurate CRM records.

Complete required inbound and outbound calls.

Keep up with assigned texting and follow-up responsibilities.

Maintain organized appointment calendars.

Minimize avoidable no-shows through proper confirmations and reminders.

Meet established activity and appointment-setting expectations.

Take initiative when additional follow-up is needed.

Communicate promptly with management regarding questions, issues, or lead concerns.

title: Operations Assistant for Growing U.S. E-commerce Store | Shopify, CRM & Customer Support
description:
Hi!



I’m looking for a reliable full-time E-commerce Operations Assistant to help with daily operations for a growing online-only store in the U.S. market.



We sell high-value products in categories such as outdoor living, e-bikes, saunas, off-grid products, power products, and lifestyle products, with more brands and product categories being added over time.



This is not a simple one-product dropshipping store. We work with multiple brands and suppliers, and many products are shipped directly from suppliers or manufacturers. Each brand can have different prices, margins, shipping rules, lead times, product details, warranties, return policies, and supplier requirements.



Because of this, attention to detail is very important. A wrong price, wrong product detail, missed follow-up, or incorrect promise to a customer can create serious problems.



This is a full-time position, not a “work whenever you want” role. Since this position involves customer emails, SMS, calls, supplier follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, Shopify tasks, and order updates, you must be available during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time.



We are still in the early stages as a business, but our goal is to grow and scale. We are looking for someone long-term, reliable, committed, detail-oriented, and proactive who can grow with us. As the business grows, tasks may become more specialized, but this role requires someone who can understand a little bit of everything at the beginning.



Responsibilities and hourly rate can increase based on performance, reliability, communication, and the value you bring to the company.



Main tasks may include:



* Responding to customer emails, SMS, and calls in English.

* Making and answering customer calls when needed.

* Following up with customers about quotes, pending payments, abandoned checkouts, delivery updates, product questions, and order issues.

* Following up with suppliers about stock, pricing, shipping, product details, lead times, tracking, freight delivery, warranty cases, and order updates.

* Updating customers about order status, delivery updates, supplier responses, delays, and next steps.

* Checking product prices, supplier costs, margins, shipping costs, MAP rules, and competitor pricing.

* Comparing our prices with U.S. competitors.

* Using a VPN when needed to view U.S. pricing, competitor websites, and product availability.

* Helping with Shopify product uploads and product updates.

* Creating, editing, and improving Shopify product listings using supplier information.

* Reviewing product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, warranty details, shipping details, and product page accuracy.

* Identifying missing product information, incorrect specs, weak descriptions, pricing issues, or product pages that need improvement.

* Keeping CRM sheets and internal spreadsheets organized.

* Updating customer notes, supplier notes, order notes, lead status, and follow-up status.

* Helping with warranty, return, cancellation, delivery, and supplier communication.

* Assisting with documentation for warranty claims, returns, delivery issues, disputes, and chargebacks when needed.

* Preparing draft responses for customer issues when needed.

* Following SOPs, training videos, examples, and instructions carefully.

* Suggesting improvements to processes, product pages, customer communication, follow-ups, spreadsheets, or SOPs after learning how the business works.



You will not be expected to know everything on day one. The first week will focus on training, onboarding, and learning how our process works. We may use Zoom calls, Google Meet calls, training videos, SOPs, examples, and internal documents to explain tasks clearly.



I prefer someone who asks questions before guessing, especially when dealing with customers, suppliers, pricing, shipping, returns, warranties, or order issues.



Important:



You should not promise customers exact delivery dates unless they are confirmed.



You should not approve refunds, returns, cancellations, discounts, disputes, or compensation unless management specifically authorizes it.



You must be careful when checking prices because different brands have different margins, supplier costs, shipping fees, MAP rules, and competitor pricing.



Requirements:



* Advanced written and spoken English for U.S. customer communication.

* Confident speaking with U.S. customers by phone in clear, professional English.

* Comfortable answering calls, making follow-up calls, replying to SMS, and handling customer issues professionally.

* Able to communicate clearly when there is a delay, delivery concern, warranty issue, return request, or customer complaint.

* Experience with Shopify, e-commerce operations, customer support, product listings, SEO edits, pricing checks, or virtual assistant work.

* Experience with high-ticket e-commerce, supplier-direct shipping, freight products, warranty cases, returns, or multi-brand online stores is strongly preferred.

* Experience using Google Sheets, CRM sheets, spreadsheets, or similar tools to stay organized.

* Available full-time during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time.

* Must have reliable internet.

* Must be able to use a VPN when needed.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Organized and able to keep accurate notes.

* Able to follow step-by-step instructions carefully.

* Able to ask questions when something is unclear instead of guessing.

* Able to work with urgency when a task is assigned.

* Able to suggest useful ideas or improvements after understanding the business process.

* Experience using Slack or similar communication tools is a plus, but not required.



Examples of tasks you may receive:



* “Check if this product is in stock with the supplier and confirm the shipping cost.”

* “Reply to this customer asking for a delivery update.”

* “Call this customer and confirm their shipping address.”

* “Call or text this customer who started checkout but did not complete the order.”

* “Compare our price with this competitor and calculate the margin.”

* “Update the CRM sheet with the customer status and next follow-up.”

* “Check if this product page is missing warranty, shipping, or specification details.”

* “Upload these products to Shopify using this supplier page.”

* “Review this product listing and improve the title, description, specifications, SEO title, and meta description.”

* “Follow up with this supplier about tracking or freight delivery.”

* “Review this customer issue and prepare a draft response.”



How to apply:



Please message me here if you are interested.



To show that you read the full post carefully, start your message with:



“Hi Chris, I can help with U.S. e-commerce operations.”



Also, somewhere in your application, mention:



“CRM sheet”



Please do not send a generic cover letter. I want to understand your real experience, communication style, and judgment, so please answer in your own words and do not use AI-generated responses.



Please include a short video recording speaking in English. This can be a Loom video, Google Drive link, or any similar link. Please make sure the link is accessible.



The video will help us evaluate your spoken English, clear pronunciation, confidence, and overall communication skills when speaking with U.S. customers.



Please do not read directly from AI-generated text or scripts. We want to hear you speaking naturally in your own words so we can better understand your real communication style and confidence level.



Please try not to read directly from a script. It is better if the video feels natural and conversational, using your own words and ideas. This helps us understand your real communication style, confidence, and how you would speak with customers.



In your message or video, please answer these questions:



1. Have you worked with Shopify, customer service, or e-commerce operations before? Explain briefly.



2. Have you worked with high-ticket e-commerce products, supplier-direct shipping, freight items, or multi-brand online stores before? If yes, please explain your experience.



3. Are you comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone in English?



4. Are you available full-time during U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time?



5. Have you used Google Sheets, CRM sheets, or spreadsheets to manage customer/order information?



6. Have you helped create, edit, or improve Shopify product listings before? If yes, what parts have you handled? For example: product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, or pricing.



7. If you have worked with other e-commerce stores before, what is one process, system, product page, or customer communication workflow you helped improve?



8. A customer asks for an exact delivery date, but the supplier only gave an estimated transit time. How would you respond?



9. Before telling a customer that a product is in stock, what would you check?



10. If a customer asks for a refund, discount, cancellation, return, dispute update, or compensation, what would you do before confirming anything?



11. Are you able to use a VPN to check U.S. competitor pricing and product availability?



12. What is your expected hourly rate?



We are looking for someone who does more than just complete assigned tasks. We value someone who can think, ask good questions, suggest improvements, and help us improve our systems as we grow.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Thanks!



Chris
